<html lang="zh-CN"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="mgd-icon-192.png">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="MGD BMS">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="mgd-icon-192.png">
  <title>业务管理系统 | Business Management System</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.1/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
  <!-- Firebase SDK -->
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/8.10.0/firebase-app.js"></script>
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/8.10.0/firebase-firestore.js"></script>
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/8.10.0/firebase-auth.js"></script>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root{--bg1:#030912;--bg2:#071325;--card:#0b1e3d;--cardh:#10274a;--blue:#00B4D8;--cyan:#06d6c7;--purple:#8b5cf6;--text1:#E8F4FF;--text2:#7FB3D8;--muted:#3D5A80;--border:#0f2d50;--glow:rgba(0,180,216,0.15)}
    /* ===== Meeting Minutes (integrated module) — scoped to avoid touching existing styles ===== */
    .mom-sheet-wrap{border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #b9c2cc;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
    .mom-sheet{background:#fff;color:#1c2530}
    .mom-sheet .mm{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;table-layout:fixed}
    .mom-sheet .mm td,.mom-sheet .mm th{border:1px solid #cdd4db;padding:6px 9px;vertical-align:top;word-wrap:break-word;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;white-space:normal}
    .mom-sheet .mm .title{background:#1F4E79;color:#fff;text-align:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;padding:12px}
    .mom-sheet .mm .lbl{background:#eef3f8;font-weight:700;color:#1F4E79;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;white-space:nowrap}
    .mom-sheet .mm .sub{background:#DCE6F1;color:#1F4E79;font-weight:700}
    .mom-sheet .mm .hdr{background:#1F4E79;color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .mom-sheet .mm .num{text-align:center;color:#5a6672;font-weight:700;font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}
    .mom-sheet .mm .ctr{text-align:center}
    .mom-sheet .mm [contenteditable]{outline:none;min-height:16px}
    .mom-sheet .mm [contenteditable]:focus{background:#fffbe6;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #ffd666;border-radius:2px}
    .mom-badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:11px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
    .mom-sel{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:none;border-radius:7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 4px;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;outline:none;text-align:center;text-align-last:center}
    .mom-sel option{color:#1c2530;background:#fff}
    .mom-inp{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font-size:10.5px;padding:1px 3px;background:transparent;color:#1c2530;font-family:inherit;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
    .mom-inp:hover{border-color:#b9c2cc;background:#fff}
    .mom-badge.g{background:#d7f2df;color:#137a3a}.mom-badge.b{background:#d4ecfb;color:#0a5f8f}.mom-badge.a{background:#fdeccb;color:#9a5b00}.mom-badge.r{background:#fbdcdc;color:#b3261e}.mom-badge.gray{background:#e6e9ed;color:#5a6672}.mom-badge.p{background:#e8e0fb;color:#5b34c0}
    .mom-mitem{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;background:var(--bg2)}
    .mom-mitem:hover{border-color:rgba(0,180,216,.5)}
    .mom-mitem.act{border-color:var(--blue);background:rgba(0,180,216,.09);box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px rgba(0,180,216,.06)}
    .mom-mitem .no{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}
    .mom-mitem .ti{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;margin:2px 0 4px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--text1)}
    .mom-mitem .mt{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px}
    /* ===== PROJECT DETAIL TRACKING (Project Follow-up) ===== */
    .pfu-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:270px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start}
    .pfu-panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
    .pfu-panel-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}
    .pfu-panel-t{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text2)}
    .pfu-item{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;background:var(--bg2);margin-bottom:6px}
    .pfu-item:hover{border-color:rgba(0,180,216,.5)}
    .pfu-item.act{border-color:var(--blue);background:rgba(0,180,216,.09)}
    .pfu-item .pn{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px}
    .pfu-item .pc{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
    .pfu-item .pb{height:4px;background:var(--border);border-radius:3px;margin-top:8px;overflow:hidden}
    .pfu-item .pb i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan));border-radius:3px}
    .pfu-item.res-cancel,.pfu-item.res-lose{opacity:.68}
    .pfu-item.res-cancel .pname,.pfu-item.res-lose .pname{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:rgba(248,113,113,.7)}
    .pfu-item.res-cancel .pb,.pfu-item.res-lose .pb{background:rgba(248,113,113,.22)}
    .pfu-item.res-cancel .pb i,.pfu-item.res-lose .pb i{background:#f87171}
    .pfu-item.res-won{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.45)}
    .pfu-item.res-won:hover{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.8)}
    .pfu-item.res-won .pb{background:rgba(34,197,94,.22)}
    .pfu-item.res-won .pb i{background:#22c55e}
    .pfu-head{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}
    .pfu-head .row1{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
    .pfu-head h2{font-size:19px;font-weight:800}
    .pfu-head .cl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px}
    .pfu-kv{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .pfu-kv div{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text2)}
    .pfu-kv b{display:block;color:var(--text1);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
    .pfu-pipe{display:flex;gap:0;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .pfu-step{flex:1;min-width:110px;position:relative;padding:11px 10px 11px 26px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-right:none;font-size:11px}
    .pfu-step:first-child{border-radius:11px 0 0 11px;padding-left:16px}
    .pfu-step:last-child{border-right:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:0 11px 11px 0}
    .pfu-step .sn{font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;display:block}
    .pfu-step .sd{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
    .pfu-step .dot{position:absolute;left:8px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);border:2px solid var(--card)}
    .pfu-step:first-child .dot{left:4px}
    .pfu-step.done{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.35)}
    .pfu-step.done .dot{background:#22c55e}
    .pfu-step.done .sn{color:#4ade80}
    .pfu-step.cur{background:rgba(0,180,216,.1);border-color:rgba(0,180,216,.45);box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,180,216,.07)}
    .pfu-step.cur .dot{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,180,216,.25)}
    .pfu-step.cur .sn{color:var(--cyan)}
    .pfu-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}
    .pfu-card-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .pfu-card-t{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
    .pfu-card-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2)}
    .pfu-tblwrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px}
    table.pfu-grid{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
    table.pfu-grid th{text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg2);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap}
    table.pfu-grid td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:top;white-space:normal}
    table.pfu-grid tr.stage-row td{background:rgba(0,180,216,.07);font-weight:700;color:var(--cyan);font-size:11.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
    table.pfu-grid tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
    table.pfu-grid tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(0,180,216,.03)}
    .pfu-av{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--purple));display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px}
    .pfu-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5}
    .pfu-note b{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:600}
    .pfu-tl{position:relative;padding-left:24px}
    .pfu-tl:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:6px;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:2px;background:var(--border)}
    .pfu-tl-i{position:relative;padding:0 0 16px 0}
    .pfu-tl-i:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-22px;top:3px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);border:2px solid var(--card);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,180,216,.25)}
    .pfu-tl-i.g:before{background:#22c55e}.pfu-tl-i.a:before{background:#f59e0b}.pfu-tl-i.p:before{background:var(--purple)}
    .pfu-tl-d{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
    .pfu-tl-t{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;margin:2px 0}
    .pfu-tl-n{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5}
    .pfu-tl-n b{color:var(--text1);font-weight:600}
    .pfu-btn{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text1);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
    .pfu-btn:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
    .pfu-btn.pri{background:var(--blue);color:#02121f;border-color:var(--blue)}
    .pfu-btn.pri:hover{opacity:.88;color:#02121f}
    .pfu-btn.sm{padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px}
    .pfu-btn.fin{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.45);color:#4ade80}
    .pfu-btn.fin:hover{border-color:#22c55e;color:#22c55e}
    .pfu-stagetag{display:inline-block;margin-left:5px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(0,180,216,.12);color:var(--cyan);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}

#docstorageContainer .modal-overlay.open {display:flex}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box {background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:24px;width:100%;max-width:520px;box-shadow:0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box h3 {font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:#000}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .field {margin-bottom:12px}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box label {display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#000;margin-bottom:3px}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box input,
#docstorageContainer .modal-box select,
#docstorageContainer .modal-box textarea {width:100%;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #d0d7e2;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-family:Arial;color:#000}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box input:focus,
#docstorageContainer .modal-box select:focus,
#docstorageContainer .modal-box textarea:focus {outline:none;border-color:#1E3A5F}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box textarea {resize:vertical;min-height:40px}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .row2 {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .actions {display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .actions button {flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:none}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .btn-cancel {background:#f0f2f5;color:#000}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .btn-save {background:#1E3A5F;color:#fff}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .btn-save:hover {background:#0f2d50}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .loc-examples {display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .loc-examples button {background:#f0f4f8;border:1px solid #d0d7e2;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;color:#000;white-space:nowrap}
#docstorageContainer .modal-box .loc-examples button:hover {background:#dce8f0}

/* ── Toast notification ── */
#docstorageContainer .toast {position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#1E3A5F;color:#fff;padding:10px 24px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;z-index:9999;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
#docstorageContainer .toast.show {opacity:1}

function updateOptionsFromData(){
  const options = getOptionsHistory();

  // 从客户数据中收集所有职位、公司业务、国家
  const positions = new Set(options.position);
  const businesses = new Set(options.companyBusiness);
  const countries = new Set(options.country);

  data.customers.forEach(c => {
    if(c.position && c.position.trim()){
      positions.add(c.position);
    }
    if(c.companyBusiness && c.companyBusiness.trim()){
      businesses.add(c.companyBusiness);
    }
    if(c.country && c.country.trim()){
      countries.add(c.country);
    }
  });

  options.position = Array.from(positions);
  options.companyBusiness = Array.from(businesses);
  options.country = Array.from(countries);

  saveOptionsHistory(options);
}

function updateCustomerStats(){
  const now=new Date();
  const thisYear=now.getFullYear();
  const thisWeek=getWeekNumber(now);
  const thisMonth=now.getMonth();

  // 2026客户统计
  const y2026=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    return new Date(c.createdDate).getFullYear()===2026;
  }).length;

  // 2025客户统计
  const y2025=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    return new Date(c.createdDate).getFullYear()===2025;
  }).length;

  // 本周新客户:基于 custDateFilter 动态计算
  const filterDate=custDateFilter?new Date(custDateFilter):null;
  const filterYear=filterDate?filterDate.getFullYear():thisYear;
  const filterWeek=filterDate?getWeekNumber(filterDate):thisWeek;
  const filterMonth=filterDate?filterDate.getMonth():thisMonth;
  const weekly=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    const d=new Date(c.createdDate);
    return d.getFullYear()===filterYear&&getWeekNumber(d)===filterWeek;
  }).length;

  // 本月新客户:基于 custDateFilter 动态计算
  const monthly=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    const d=new Date(c.createdDate);
    return d.getFullYear()===filterYear&&d.getMonth()===filterMonth;
  }).length;

  const el2026=document.getElementById('cust2026');
  const el2025=document.getElementById('cust2025');
  const elWeek=document.getElementById('custWeek');
  const elMonth=document.getElementById('custMonth');

  if(el2026)el2026.textContent=y2026;
  if(el2025)el2025.textContent=y2025;
  if(elWeek)elWeek.textContent=weekly;
  if(elMonth)elMonth.textContent=monthly;
}

function getWeekNumber(d){
  const date=new Date(d);
  date.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  // Saturday-based weeks: find first Saturday of year, then calculate week number
  const year=date.getFullYear();
  const jan1=new Date(year,0,1);
  const daysToSaturday=(6-jan1.getDay()+7)%7;
  const firstSaturday=new Date(jan1);
  firstSaturday.setDate(jan1.getDate()+daysToSaturday);
  if(date<firstSaturday)return 1;
  const diffDays=Math.floor((date-firstSaturday)/(1000*60*60*24));
  return Math.floor(diffDays/7)+2;
}

function momGetData(){
  if(!data.meetingMinutes||!data.meetingMinutes.records){data.meetingMinutes={seq:12,records:momSeedRecords(),migVersion:3};return data.meetingMinutes;}
  if(data.meetingMinutes.migVersion!==3){
    var _r=data.meetingMinutes.records||[];
    var _ids=_r.map(function(x){return x.id;}).sort().join(',');
    if(_ids==='MOM-008,MOM-009,MOM-010,MOM-011,MOM-012'){
      data.meetingMinutes.records=momSeedRecords();
      data.meetingMinutes.seq=12;
    }else{
      _r.forEach(function(rec){rec.agenda=momNormAgenda(rec.agenda);rec.actions=momNormActions(rec.actions);});
    }
    data.meetingMinutes.migVersion=3;
    try{if(typeof saveData==='function')saveData();}catch(e){}
  }
  return data.meetingMinutes;
}

function momPick(id){momCollect();momCurrentId=id;momRenderList();momRenderSheet();}
function momNormActions(ac){
  if(!ac||!ac.length)ac=[{topic:'',items:[]}];
  var _new={task:'',pic:'',due:'',priority:'Medium',status:'Pending',next:'',remark:'—'};
  var _isSec=function(s){return s&&typeof s==='object'&&!Array.isArray(s)&&(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s,'items')||Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s,'topic'));};
  if(!_isSec(ac[0])){
    var _flat=ac.filter(function(a){return !_isSec(a);});
    return [{topic:'',items:_flat.map(function(a){var o={};_new&&Object.keys(_new).forEach(function(k){o[k]=a[k]!=null?a[k]:_new[k];});return o;})}];
  }
  return ac.map(function(g){
    var topic=(g&&typeof g.topic==='string')?g.topic:'';
    var items=(g&&Array.isArray(g.items))?g.items.map(function(a){var o={};Object.keys(_new).forEach(function(k){o[k]=a&&a[k]!=null?a[k]:_new[k];});return o;}):[];
    return {topic:topic,items:items};
  });
}

function momNormAgenda(ag){
  if(!ag||!ag.length)ag=[{topic:'',items:['']}];
  return ag.map(function(g){
    if(typeof g==='string'){var parts=g.split(/\s+[·—–-]\s+/);var tp=parts.shift()||'';return {topic:tp,items:parts.length?parts:['']};}
    var topic=(g&&typeof g.topic==='string')?g.topic:'';
    var items=(g&&Array.isArray(g.items))?g.items.slice():((g&&g.detail)?[String(g.detail)]:['']);
    return {topic:topic,items:items.length?items:['']};
  });
}

function initWeeklyReport(){
  if(!data.weeklyReports)data.weeklyReports={};
  if(!data.weeklyReports.users)data.weeklyReports.users={};
  ['tony','quoc','huong'].forEach(function(u){if(!data.weeklyReports.users[u])data.weeklyReports.users[u]={};});
}


function getWeekDates(weekNum,year){
  year=year||2026;
  // Find first Saturday of the year (Week 1 starts from first Saturday)
  var jan1=new Date(year,0,1);
  var daysToSaturday=(6-jan1.getDay()+7)%7; // Days until first Saturday
  var week1Saturday=new Date(jan1);
  week1Saturday.setDate(jan1.getDate()+daysToSaturday);
  var targetSaturday=new Date(week1Saturday);
  targetSaturday.setDate(week1Saturday.getDate()+(weekNum-2)*7);
  var targetNextSaturday=new Date(targetSaturday);
  targetNextSaturday.setDate(targetSaturday.getDate()+7);
  var months=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return{start:months[targetSaturday.getMonth()]+' '+targetSaturday.getDate()+', '+targetSaturday.getFullYear(),end:months[targetNextSaturday.getMonth()]+' '+targetNextSaturday.getDate()+', '+targetNextSaturday.getFullYear()};
}

function wrAutoCalculate(user,taskId){
  var planStart=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-start');
  var planEnd=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-end');
  var planDays=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-days');
  if(planStart&&planEnd&&planDays){
    var start=planStart.value?new Date(planStart.value):null;
    var end=planEnd.value?new Date(planEnd.value):null;
    if(start&&end&&!isNaN(start)&&!isNaN(end)){
      var days=Math.ceil((end-start)/(1000*60*60*24));
      planDays.textContent=days>=0?days:'-';
    }else{
      planDays.textContent='-';
    }
  }
}


function wrUpdateStatusColor(sel){
  var v=sel.value;
  var bg={'In Progress':'rgba(245,158,11,0.2)','Completed':'rgba(34,197,94,0.2)','Delay':'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)'};
  var fg={'In Progress':'#fbbf24','Completed':'#22c55e','Delay':'#ef4444'};
  if(bg[v]){sel.style.background=bg[v];sel.style.color=fg[v];}
  else{sel.style.background='var(--bg2)';sel.style.color='var(--text)';}

function wrUpdateFromPct(user,taskId,pctVal){
  var pctInput=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-pct');
  if(!pctInput)return;
  var clamped=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,parseInt(pctVal,10)||0));
  pctInput.value=clamped;
  // Auto-set Status based on %
  var statusSelect=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-status');
  var statusTxt=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-status-txt');
  var newStatus;
  if(clamped===100) newStatus='Completed';
  else if(clamped>=1) newStatus='In Progress';
  else newStatus='Delay'; // 0%
  if(statusSelect){
    statusSelect.value=newStatus;
    wrUpdateStatusColor(statusSelect);
  }
  if(statusTxt){
    var fg={'In Progress':'#fbbf24','Completed':'#22c55e','Delay':'#ef4444'};
    statusTxt.textContent=newStatus;
    statusTxt.style.color=fg[newStatus];
  }
}

function wrDeleteTask(user,taskId){
  if(!confirm('Delete this task?'))return;
  // Remove from data layer first
  var weekData=data.weeklyReports.users[user]&&data.weeklyReports.users[user][wrCurrentWeek];
  if(weekData&&weekData.tasks){
    weekData.tasks.splice(taskId-1,1);
  }
  // Remove DOM element
  var taskEl=document.getElementById('wr-task-'+user+'-'+taskId);
  if(taskEl)taskEl.remove();
  // Renumber remaining tasks both in DOM and data
  var container=document.getElementById('wrTableContainer');
  if(!container)return;
  var groups=container.querySelectorAll('.wr-task-group');
  groups.forEach(function(group,idx){
    var newNum=idx+1;
    var oldNum=parseInt(group.id.replace('wr-task-'+user+'-',''));
    if(newNum===oldNum)return;
    group.id='wr-task-'+user+'-'+newNum;
    // Update # header number
    var headerRow=group.querySelector('div');
    if(headerRow){
      var firstCell=headerRow.children[0];
      if(firstCell)firstCell.textContent='#'+newNum;
    }
    // Update element IDs
    var suffixs=['-name','-start','-end','-days','-status','-pct','-noted'];
    suffixs.forEach(function(suf){
      var oldEl=document.getElementById(user+'-'+oldNum+suf);
      if(oldEl)oldEl.id=user+'-'+newNum+suf;
    });
    // Update delete button onclick
    var delBtn=group.querySelector('button');
    if(delBtn)delBtn.setAttribute('onclick',"wrDeleteTask('"+user+"',"+newNum+")");
    // Update date input onchange
    var dateInputs=group.querySelectorAll('input[type="date"]');
    dateInputs.forEach(function(inp){
      inp.setAttribute('onchange',"wrAutoCalculate('"+user+"',"+newNum+")");
    });
  });
  // Save to localStorage
  localStorage.setItem('weeklyReports',JSON.stringify(data.weeklyReports));
  wrShowToast('Task deleted & renumbered!','success');
}

function saveWeeklyReport(){
  initWeeklyReport();
  var tasks=[];
  var container=document.getElementById('wrTableContainer');
  if(!container)return;
  var groups=container.querySelectorAll('.wr-task-group');
  groups.forEach(function(group){
    // Extract actual taskId from group.id (e.g. 'wr-task-tony-3' -> 3)
    var taskId=parseInt(group.id.replace('wr-task-'+wrCurrentUser+'-',''));
    var name=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-name');
    var planStart=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-start');
    var planEnd=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-end');
    var planStatus=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-status');
    var noted=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-noted');
    var pctVal=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-pct');
    tasks.push({id:taskId,name:name?name.value:'',planStart:planStart?planStart.value:'',planEnd:planEnd?planEnd.value:'',taskStatus:planStatus?planStatus.value:'',pct:pctVal?pctVal.value:'',noted:noted?noted.value:''});
  });
  data.weeklyReports.users[wrCurrentUser][wrCurrentWeek]={week:wrCurrentWeek,tasks:tasks,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  saveData();
  wrTaskCounter[wrCurrentUser]=tasks.length;
  wrUpdateRecordsCount();
  wrShowToast('Week '+wrCurrentWeek+' saved!','success');

  // ===== AUTO CARRY-FORWARD: Always copy tasks to next week on every save =====
  var nextWeek=wrCurrentWeek+1;
  if(nextWeek>52)return; // Don't carry beyond week 52
  if(tasks.length>0){
    var carriedTasks=tasks.map(function(t,idx){
      return{
        id:idx+1,
        name:t.name||'',
        planStart:t.planStart||'',
        planEnd:t.planEnd||'',
        taskStatus:'In Progress',
        pct:t.pct||'50',
        noted:t.noted||''
      };
    });
    data.weeklyReports.users[wrCurrentUser][nextWeek]={week:nextWeek,tasks:carriedTasks,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
    saveData();
    wrShowToast('Tasks carried forward to Week '+nextWeek,'info');
  }
}

function wrClearAllData(){
  if(!data.weeklyReports||!data.weeklyReports.users)return;
  var users=Object.keys(data.weeklyReports.users);
  users.forEach(function(u){
    var weeks=Object.keys(data.weeklyReports.users[u]);
    weeks.forEach(function(w){
      // Only clear pct and taskStatus, keep other fields
      if(data.weeklyReports.users[u][w]&&data.weeklyReports.users[u][w].tasks){
        data.weeklyReports.users[u][w].tasks.forEach(function(t){
          t.pct='';
          t.taskStatus='';
          t.planStart='';
          t.planEnd='';
          t.noted='';
        });
      }
    });
  });
  saveData();
  console.log('[CLEAR] All weekly report %/Status/Days cleared');
  // Re-render if weekly report is visible
  if(document.getElementById('wrTableContainer'))initWeeklyReport();
}

function darken(hex){

}

// ── Project Follow-up → 营收：最终结果 = Won 的项目按 Est. Value 计入 Revenue Target ──
function pfuVNDtoB(v){
  if(v==null)return 0;
  var s=String(v).trim();
  if(!s||s==='\u2014'||s==='-'||/^n\/a$/i.test(s))return 0;
  if(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(s))return 0;              // 日期串不当作金额
  var mB=s.match(/([\d][\d.,]*)\s*[bB](?![A-Za-z])/);
  if(mB){var n1=parseFloat(mB[1].replace(/,/g,''));return isNaN(n1)?0:n1;}
  var mM=s.match(/([\d][\d.,]*)\s*[mM](?![A-Za-z])/);
  if(mM){var n2=parseFloat(mM[1].replace(/,/g,''));return isNaN(n2)?0:n2/1000;}
  var m=s.match(/([\d][\d.,]*)/); if(!m)return 0;
  var n3=parseFloat(m[1].replace(/,/g,'')); if(isNaN(n3))return 0;
  return n3/1e9;                                          // 纯 VND → B
}
function pfuWonRevenue(){
  var res={total:0,items:[]};
  var bids=data.bids||[];
  function norm(x){return String(x||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00c0-\u024f\u1ea0-\u1eff]/g,'');}
  function same(a,b){a=norm(a);b=norm(b);if(!a||!b)return false;return a===b||a.indexOf(b)>=0||b.indexOf(a)>=0;}
  (data.projectTracking||[]).forEach(function(pp){
    var st=((pp.result||{}).status)||'';
    if(st!=='Won')return;
    var val=pfuVNDtoB(pp.estValue);
    if(!val)return;
    // 去重：同一项目已在 Bid Tracking 以中标计入则不重复累加
    var dup=bids.some(function(b){
      if(b.inactive)return false;
      var sc=String(b.stageContent||'');
      if(sc.indexOf('\u4e2d\u6807')===-1&&!/(^|[^a-z])won([^a-z]|$)/i.test(sc))return false;
      return same(pp.name,b.projectName)||same(pp.name,b.customerName);
    });
    if(dup)return;
    res.total+=val; res.items.push({name:pp.name,val:val});
  });
  return res;
}

function updateStats(){
  const sm={
    '潜在':'c3','潜在 / Potential':'c3','Potential':'c3','Potential / 潜在':'c3',
    '中标':'c5','中标 / Won':'c5','Won':'c5','Won / 中标':'c5',
    '未中标':'c5','未中标 / Lost':'c5','Lost':'c5','Lost / 未中标':'c5'
  };
  // 阶段内容映射(基于 stageContent,非投标阶段 stage)
  const scm={
    '投标中':'c2','投标中 / Bidding':'c2','Bidding':'c2','Bidding / 投标中':'c2',
    '跟踪':'c4','跟踪 / Following':'c4','Following':'c4','Following / 跟踪':'c4','跟踪 / Follow up':'c4','Follow up':'c4','Follow up / 跟踪':'c4',
    '潜在':'c3','潜在 / Potential':'c3','Potential':'c3','Potential / 潜在':'c3'
  };
  const c={c1:0,c2:0,c3:0,c4:0,c5:0,ca:0,cba:0};
  // 项目统计:跟随 Summary 页面 sumBidsTotal
  c.c1 = data.bids.length;
  // 阶段统计:排除已取消,基于 stageContent
  data.bids.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.inactive) return;
    // 优先用阶段内容判断投标中/跟踪
    const scKey=scm[b.stageContent];
    if(scKey){c[scKey]++;return;}
    // 其他阶段走原逻辑
    const k=sm[b.stage];
    if(k) c[k]++;
  });
  // 统计分类(含已取消)
  c.ca = data.bids.filter(b=>b.category==='A'||b.category==='A工程').length;
  c.cba = data.bids.filter(b=>b.category==='B'||b.category==='B工程').length;
  Object.keys(c).forEach(k=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(k);
    if(el) el.textContent=c[k];
  });
  // 计算预估工程金额总额(仅统计活跃管道: Bidding + Potential,排除 Tracking/Cancelled 及其他阶段)
  const ACTIVE_STAGE_KEYWORDS = [['Bidding','投标中'],['Potential','潜在']];
  let totalVal = 0;
  data.bids.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.inactive) return; // 已取消项目不计入
    const sc=(b.stageContent||'').toLowerCase();
    const inActive = ACTIVE_STAGE_KEYWORDS.some(kw=>kw.some(x=>sc.indexOf(x.toLowerCase())!==-1));
    if(!inActive) return; // 仅统计活跃管道三个阶段
    const num = parseFloat(String(b.estimatedValue).replace(/,/g,''));
    if(!isNaN(num)) totalVal += num;
  });
  const tvEl = document.getElementById('totalValue');
  if(tvEl){
    if(totalVal >= 1000000000) tvEl.textContent = (totalVal/1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'B';
    else if(totalVal >= 1000000) tvEl.textContent = (totalVal/1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'M';
    else if(totalVal >= 1000) tvEl.textContent = (totalVal/1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'K';
    else tvEl.textContent = totalVal.toLocaleString();
  }
}

    }else if(bidsFilter==='tracking'){
      d=d.filter(b=>!b.inactive&&(b.stageContent==='跟踪'||b.stageContent==='跟踪 / Following'||b.stageContent==='Following'||b.stageContent==='Following / 跟踪'||b.stageContent==='跟踪 / Follow up'||b.stageContent==='Follow up'||b.stageContent==='Follow up / 跟踪'));
    }else if(bidsFilter==='potential'){

function cyclePriority(id){
  const order=['中 / Medium','高 / High','低 / Low'];
  const item=data.customers.find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!item) return;
  const cur=item.priority||'';
  let idx=order.indexOf(cur);
  if(idx===-1) idx=0; else idx=(idx+1)%order.length;
  item.priority=order[idx];
  saveData();
  renderTable();
}

function saveInlineEdit(id,k){
  try{
    const item=data[mod].find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!item) return;
    var oldValue=item[k];
    var newValue=document.getElementById('ied_'+k).value;
    item[k]=newValue;
    // 如果是 projects 模块且修改的是 interactionDate,则 interactionCount +1
    if(mod==='projects' && k==='interactionDate'){
      if(typeof item.interactionCount!=='number') item.interactionCount=0;
      if(newValue && newValue.trim()!=='' && oldValue!==newValue){
        item.interactionCount++;
      }
    }
    saveData();
    renderTable();
    if(mod==='bids') updateStats();
    if(mod==='projects') updateSummary();
  }catch(e){console.error('[saveInlineEdit ERROR]',e);alert('保存失败: '+e.message);}
}

function exportCustomerTemplate(){
  const isEn = typeof lang !== 'undefined' && lang === 'en';
  const headers = isEn
    ? ['Company Name','Business','Contact Person','Position','Phone','Email','Country','Priority (High/Med/Low)','Date Added']
    : ['公司名称','公司业务','联系人','职位','电话','邮箱','国家','优先级(高/中/低)','添加日期'];
  // 只导出表头和空白行，不导标题行（避免导入时误把标题当数据）
  const sheetName = isEn ? 'Customers' : '客户管理';
  const fileName = isEn ? 'CustomerManagement_Template.xlsx' : '客户管理_空白模板.xlsx';
  // 10行空白模板
  const blankRows = Array.from({length:10}, ()=>Array(headers.length).fill(''));
  const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([headers, ...blankRows]);
  ws['!cols'] = headers.map(() => ({wch:25}));

var _pendingToolAction = null;

function toggleToolMenu(e){
  e.stopPropagation();

  if(!menu)return;
  var shown=menu.style.display==='block';
  menu.style.display=shown?'none':'block';

}
function closeToolMenu(e){
  var menu=document.getElementById('toolMenu');
  if(menu)menu.style.display='none';
  document.removeEventListener('click',closeToolMenu);
}

function requirePassword(actionFn,label){
  _pendingToolAction=actionFn;
  var overlay=document.createElement('div');
  overlay.id='pwOverlay';
  var existing=document.getElementById('pwOverlay');
  if(existing)existing.remove();
  overlay.innerHTML='<div id="pwBox"><h3>🔐 '+label+'</h3><input type="password" id="pwInput" placeholder="输入管理密码" autocomplete="off"><div id="pwError"></div><div class="pw-actions"><button class="pw-cancel" onclick="removePwOverlay()">取消</button><button class="pw-confirm" onclick="checkPwAndRun()">确认</button></div></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  setTimeout(function(){
    var inp=document.getElementById('pwInput');
    if(inp){inp.focus();inp.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter')checkPwAndRun();});}
  },100);
}
function removePwOverlay(){
  var el=document.getElementById('pwOverlay');
  if(el)el.remove();
  _pendingToolAction=null;
}
function checkPwAndRun(){
  var inp=document.getElementById('pwInput');
  var err=document.getElementById('pwError');
  if(!inp||!err)return;
  if(inp.value==='MGD2026'){
    var action=_pendingToolAction;
    removePwOverlay();
    if(action){action();}
  }else{
    err.textContent='❌ 密码错误，请重试';
    inp.value='';
    inp.focus();
  }
}

function backupAll(){
  // ⚡ Flush all in-memory data to localStorage first
  if(typeof saveData === 'function') saveData();
  if(typeof docPersist === 'function') docPersist();

  var backup = {};
  // 保存所有 localStorage 中的数据
  for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
    var key = localStorage.key(i);
    try { backup[key] = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)); }
    catch(e) { backup[key] = localStorage.getItem(key); }
  }
  // 嵌入完整系统代码（index.html），万一重装无需再从 GitHub 拉
  backup._sourceCode = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
  var jsonStr = JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2);
  var blob = new Blob([jsonStr], {type: 'application/json'});
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  a.download = 'BMS_Full_Backup_' + date + '.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }, 1000);
  wrShowToast ? wrShowToast('✅ Full backup complete','success') : alert(t('es'));
}

function restoreAll(event){
  var file = event.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    try {
      var backup = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      var count = 0;
      for (var key in backup) {
        if(key==='_sourceCode') continue; // 代码在恢复数据时不写入 localStorage
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(backup[key]));
        count++;
      }
      var codeStr = backup._sourceCode;
      if(codeStr){
        // 也存一份到 localStorage 供手动下载
        localStorage.setItem('_bms_backup_code', codeStr);
        var blob = new Blob([codeStr], {type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8'});
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = 'index.html';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        setTimeout(function(){document.body.removeChild(a);URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);},1000);
      }
      // Push restored data to Firestore before reloading
      if(typeof fdb !== 'undefined'){
        var bmsData = localStorage.getItem('bms_data');
        if(bmsData){
          try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(bmsData);
            fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').set({ data: parsed, updatedBy: 'restore', updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() })
              .then(function(){ console.log('[Restore] Synced to Firestore OK'); location.reload(); })
              .catch(function(e){ console.log('[Restore] Firestore push failed:', e.message); location.reload(); });
          } catch(e){ location.reload(); }
        } else { location.reload(); }
      } else { location.reload(); }
    } catch(err) {
      alert('恢复失败: ' + err.message + '\nRestore failed: ' + err.message);
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
}

function showCloudSnapshots(){
  if(!fauth || !fauth.currentUser && localStorage.getItem('bms_logged_in') !== '1'){
    wrShowToast('Please login first','error'); return;
  }
  // Create modal overlay
  var ov = document.createElement('div');
  ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);z-index:99998;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
  var box = document.createElement('div');
  box.style.cssText = 'background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;max-width:520px;width:90%;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;color:var(--text);font-size:13px;';
  box.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;"><h3 style="margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;">☁️ Cloud Snapshots</h3><button onclick="this.closest(\'div[style]\').parentElement.parentElement.remove()" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text2);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;">✕</button></div><div id="snapshotList" style="min-height:80px;"><p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;">Loading snapshots...</p></div>';
  ov.appendChild(box);
  document.body.appendChild(ov);

  // Fetch snapshots from Firestore
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').collection('snapshots')
    .orderBy('__name__', 'desc').limit(50).get()
    .then(function(snap){
      var list = document.getElementById('snapshotList');
      if(!list) return;
      if(snap.empty){
        list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;padding:20px 0;">No snapshots yet. Save some data first.</p>';
        return;
      }
      var html = '<div style="margin-bottom:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);">Click a snapshot to restore (will overwrite current data):</div>';
      snap.forEach(function(docSnap){
        var ts = docSnap.id;
        var display = ts.replace(/(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/, '$1-$2-$3 $4:$5:$6');
        var updatedBy = docSnap.data().updatedBy || 'unknown';
        html += '<div onclick="restoreFromCloud(\''+ts+'\')" style="padding:10px 14px;margin:4px 0;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transition:0.15s;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--accent)\';this.style.color=\'#fff\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'var(--bg2)\';this.style.color=\'var(--text)\'">';
        html += '<span style="font-weight:600;">'+display+'</span>';
        html += '<span style="font-size:11px;opacity:0.7;">'+updatedBy+'</span>';
        html += '</div>';
      });
      list.innerHTML = html;
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      var list = document.getElementById('snapshotList');
      if(list) list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--danger);text-align:center;">Error: '+e.message+'</p>';
    });
}

function restoreFromCloud(ts){
  if(!confirm('Restore snapshot '+ts+'?\n\nThis will overwrite ALL current data. Are you sure?')) return;
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').collection('snapshots').doc(ts).get()
    .then(function(docSnap){
      if(!docSnap.exists){
        wrShowToast('Snapshot not found','error'); return;
      }
      var snapData = docSnap.data().data || docSnap.data();
      // Write back to master
      return fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').set({ data: snapData, updatedBy: 'restore('+ts+')', updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });
    })
    .then(function(){
      wrShowToast('✅ Restored snapshot '+ts.replace(/(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/, '$1-$2-$3 $4:$5:$6'),'success');
      // Close modal
      var ov = document.querySelector('div[style*="z-index:99998"]');
      if(ov) ov.remove();
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      wrShowToast('Restore failed: '+e.message,'error');
    });
}

function importData(event){
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;

  const fileName = file.name.toLowerCase();

  // Excel 文件导入(使用 SheetJS)
  if(fileName.endsWith('.xls') || fileName.endsWith('.xlsx') || fileName.endsWith('.xlsm') || fileName.endsWith('.xml')){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e){
      try{
        const data2 = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
        const workbook = XLSX.read(data2, {type: 'array'});

        // 遍历所有工作表
        workbook.SheetNames.forEach(sheetName => {
          console.log('发现工作表:', sheetName);
          const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
          const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, {header: 1});

          console.log('工作表', sheetName, '数据行数:', jsonData.length);
          if(jsonData.length > 0) {
            console.log('第一行(标题):', jsonData[0]);
            console.log('第二行(数据):', jsonData[1]);
          }

          if(jsonData.length < 2) return; // 跳过空表

          // 跳过标题行,获取数据行
          const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1).filter(row => row.some(cell => cell && String(cell).trim() !== ''));

          console.log('工作表', sheetName, '有效数据行数:', dataRows.length);

          // 根据工作表名称导入数据(严格匹配,避免误判)
          const sheetNameLower = sheetName.toLowerCase();
          if(sheetNameLower.includes('投标') || sheetNameLower.includes('bid')){

              existingKeys.add(key);

      }
    };
    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
  }
  // CSV 文件导入
  else if(fileName.endsWith('.csv')){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e){
      try{
        const text = e.target.result;
        const lines = text.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());

        if(lines.length < 2){
          alert('CSV文件为空或格式不正确');
          return;
        }

        // 解析CSV行
        const parseCSVLine = (line) => {
          const result = [];
          let current = '';
          let inQuotes = false;
          for(let i = 0; i < line.length; i++){
            const char = line[i];
            if(char === '"'){
              if(inQuotes && line[i+1] === '"'){
                current += '"';
                i++;
              }else{
                inQuotes = !inQuotes;
              }
            }else if(char === ',' && !inQuotes){
              result.push(current);
              current = '';
            }else{
              current += char;
            }
          }
          result.push(current);
          return result;
        };

        const dataRows = [];
        for(let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++){
          const row = parseCSVLine(lines[i]);
          if(row.some(v => v && v.trim() !== '')){
            dataRows.push(row);
          }
        }

        // 根据文件名判断导入哪个模块
        if(fileName.includes('投标')){
          data.bids = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'B-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,

            projectName: row[1] || '',
            location: row[2] || '',

            estimatedValue: row[9] || ''
          }));
          saveData();
          updateStats();
          renderTable();
          alert(`投标项目导入成功!共${data.bids.length}条记录`);
        }
        else if(fileName.includes('客户管理') || fileName.includes('客户')){
          data.customers = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'C-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            companyName: row[0] || '',
            companyBusiness: row[1] || '',
            contactPerson: row[2] || '',
            position: row[3] || '',

          }));
          saveData();
          updateCustomerStats();
          renderTable();
          alert(`客户管理导入成功!共${data.customers.length}条记录`);
        }
        else if(fileName.includes('互动')){
          data.projects = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'I-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            customerName: row[0] || '',
            interactionDate: row[1] || '',
            interactionType: row[2] || '',
            content: row[3] || '',
            personInCharge: row[4] || '',

          }));
          saveData();

          alert(`客户互动导入成功!共${data.projects.length}条记录`);
        }
        else if(fileName.includes('商会')){
          data.chambers = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'CH-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            chamberName: row[0] || '',

          alert(`商会信息导入成功!共${data.chambers.length}条记录`);
        }
        else{
          alert('无法识别CSV文件类型,请确保文件名包含:投标、客户管理、互动、商会');
        }
      }catch(err){
        alert('CSV导入失败: ' + err.message);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }
  // JSON 文件导入
  else if(fileName.endsWith('.json')){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e){
      try{
        const imported = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
        if(imported.data){
          if(confirm(t('ic'))){

      }

    reader.readAsText(file);
  }
  else{
    alert('不支持的文件格式,请使用 .xls 或 .json 文件');
  }
  event.target.value = '';
}

function doSave(){
  console.log('[SAVE] doSave called. mod =', mod, '| eid =', eid);
  try {
    if (!data[mod]) {
      alert('错误:模块数据未初始化');
      return;
    }

    const fm = document.getElementById('mf');
    if (!fm) {
      alert('错误:找不到表单元素');
      return;
    }

    console.log('[SAVE] Form found, fields:', fm.querySelectorAll('input, select, .fi-t, .fi-ta').length);
    const item = {id: eid || mod.toUpperCase().slice(0,3)+'-'+Date.now()};

    // 取 select 的值
    fm.querySelectorAll('select').forEach(sel => {
      if (sel.name) item[sel.name] = sel.value;
    });

    // 取原生日期输入框的值
    fm.querySelectorAll('input[type="date"]').forEach(inp => {
      if (inp.dataset.k) item[inp.dataset.k] = inp.value;
    });

    // 取 input[list] datalist 的值
    fm.querySelectorAll('input[list]').forEach(function(el) {
      var k = el.dataset.k;
      if (k) item[k] = el.value || '';
    });
    // 取 contenteditable div 和 input 的值(纯文本/value,用于保存)
    fm.querySelectorAll('.fi-t,.fi-ta').forEach(function(el) {
      var k = el.dataset.k;
      if (!k) return;
      if (el.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        item[k] = el.value || '';
      } else {
        item[k] = el.textContent || '';
      }
    });

    if(eid){
      const idx = data[mod].findIndex(i => i.id === eid);
      console.log('[EDIT] Updating. eid =', eid, '| idx found =', idx);
      if(idx !== -1){
        var oldItem = data[mod][idx];
        if(mod==='projects'){
          var oldDate = oldItem.interactionDate||'';
          var newDate = item.interactionDate||'';
          // 改了日期 -> 又互动了一次 -> +1
          if(oldDate !== newDate){
            var baseCount = (typeof oldItem.interactionCount==='number') ? oldItem.interactionCount : 0;
            item.interactionCount = baseCount + 1;
          } else {
            item.interactionCount = (typeof oldItem.interactionCount==='number') ? oldItem.interactionCount : 0;
          }
        }
        console.log('[EDIT] Before update:', JSON.stringify(data[mod][idx]));
        data[mod][idx] = item;
        console.log('[EDIT] After update:', JSON.stringify(data[mod][idx]));
      } else {
        console.log('[EDIT] WARN: idx not found, pushing as NEW item');
        data[mod].push(item);
      }
    }else{
      // Set createdDate for new customers if not already set
      if(mod==='customers' && !item.createdDate){
        const today=new Date();
        const y=today.getFullYear();
        const m=String(today.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
        const d=String(today.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
        item.createdDate=y+'-'+m+'-'+d;
      }
      data[mod].push(item);
      console.log('[SAVE] Pushed new item. Total', mod, 'now:', data[mod].length);
    }

    saveData();
    console.log('[SAVE] Data saved to localStorage');
    updateOptionsFromData();
    updateStats();
    updateSummary();
    renderTable();
    console.log('[SAVE] Table rendered');

    eid = null;
    cm();

    console.log('[SAVE] Modal closed, alert shown');
    alert('保存成功!');
  } catch(err) {
    alert('保存出错: ' + err.message);
  }
}

// 手动调整第一列宽度
let colResize={active:false,startX:0,startWidth:0};
function startColResize(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  colResize.active=true;
  colResize.startX=e.clientX;
  const th=e.target.parentElement;
  colResize.startWidth=th.offsetWidth;
  document.addEventListener('mousemove',doColResize);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup',stopColResize);
}
function doColResize(e){
  if(!colResize.active)return;
  const dx=e.clientX-colResize.startX;
  const newWidth=Math.max(80,colResize.startWidth+dx);
  document.querySelectorAll('#dt .col-customer').forEach(el=>el.style.minWidth=newWidth+'px');
  document.querySelectorAll('#dt .col-customer').forEach(el=>el.style.width=newWidth+'px');
}
function stopColResize(){
  colResize.active=false;
  document.removeEventListener('mousemove',doColResize);
  document.removeEventListener('mouseup',stopColResize);
}

  });

  // Pre-compute parent row pct averages from sub/leaf children
  var parentPctMap = {};

    if(!p.no.includes('.')){
      var subs = items.filter(function(it){ return it.no.startsWith(p.no + '.') && (it.no.match(/\./g) || []).length === 1; });

          if(leafs.length > 0){
            var lt = 0, lc = 0;
            leafs.forEach(function(lf){ var lv = parseFloat(lf.cumulative); if(!isNaN(lv) && lv >= 0){ lt += lv; lc++; } });
            if(lc > 0){ pt += Math.round(lt / lc); pc++; }

        });

        });

// Live-update sub/parent row pct display when leaf cumulative changes
function updatePctRowDisplay(){
  var tbody = document.querySelector('#planTrackingContainer table tbody');
  if(!tbody) return;
  var trs = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
  // leaf -> sub mapping
  var subData = {}; // subNo -> [values]
  trs.forEach(function(tr){
    var cells = tr.cells;
    if(!cells || cells.length < 3) return;
    var no = (cells[0].textContent||'').trim();
    var dots = (no.match(/\./g)||[]).length;
    if(dots === 2){ // leaf row
      var subNo = no.split('.').slice(0,2).join('.');
      var cumInput = tr.querySelector('input[data-k="cumulative"]');
      if(cumInput){
        var v = parseFloat(cumInput.value);
        if(!isNaN(v) && v >= 0){
          if(!subData[subNo]) subData[subNo] = [];
          subData[subNo].push(Math.min(Math.round(v), 100));
        }
      }
    }
  });
  // Update sub and parent rows
  trs.forEach(function(tr){
    var cells = tr.cells;
    if(!cells || cells.length < 3) return;
    var no = (cells[0].textContent||'').trim();
    var dots = (no.match(/\./g)||[]).length;
    var td2 = cells[2]; // Column 3 (pct)
    if(!td2) return;
    if(dots === 1){ // sub row
      var vals = subData[no];
      if(vals && vals.length > 0){
        var avg = Math.round(vals.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;}) / vals.length);
        td2.textContent = avg + '%';
        td2.style.color = avg >= 100 ? '#10b981' : (avg > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
      }
    } else if(dots === 0){ // parent row
      var parentSubs = [];
      for(var sn in subData){
        if(sn.split('.')[0] === no){
          var svals = subData[sn];
          if(svals && svals.length > 0){
            parentSubs.push(Math.round(svals.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;}) / svals.length));
          }
        }
      }
      if(parentSubs.length > 0){
        var pavg = Math.round(parentSubs.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;}) / parentSubs.length);
        td2.textContent = pavg + '%';
        td2.style.color = pavg >= 100 ? '#10b981' : (pavg > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
      }
    }
  });
}

// PLAN 2026 spell check: common business words with frequent typos
var PLAN_SPELL_MAP = {
  'Standar': 'Standard', 'Standars': 'Standards', 'standar': 'standard',

};

function checkPlanSpelling(items){
  var issues = [];
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var c = (it.content||'').trim();
    if(!c) return;
    var words = c.split(/[^A-Za-z]+/).filter(function(w){ return w.length > 0; });
    words.forEach(function(w){
      var good = PLAN_SPELL_MAP[w];
      if(good && good !== w){
        var idx = c.indexOf(w);
        var bad = c.substring(idx, idx + w.length);
        issues.push({no: it.no, bad: bad, good: good, full: c});
      }
    });
  });
  return issues;
}

// Add child row under a parent/sub node
function addChildRow(parentNo, rootNo){
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  var parentDepth = parentNo.split('.').length;
  // Find direct children only (exactly one more depth level) and track insert position
  var children = [];
  var insertIdx = -1;
  var parentIdx = -1;
  for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
    var n = items[i].no;
    if(n === parentNo) { parentIdx = i; }
    if(n.startsWith(parentNo + '.')){
      var d = n.split('.').length;
      if(d === parentDepth + 1){ children.push({no: n, idx: i}); }
      insertIdx = i + 1;
    } else if(insertIdx > 0) { break; }
  }
  if(insertIdx < 0) {
    // No children found — insert right after parent, not at end of list
    insertIdx = parentIdx >= 0 ? parentIdx + 1 : items.length;
  }
  // Find next sequential number (e.g. 1,2,4 → use 5, not 3)
  var childNums = children.map(function(c){ return parseInt(c.no.split('.').pop()); });
  var newNum = childNums.length > 0 ? Math.max.apply(null, childNums) + 1 : 1;
  var newNo = parentNo + '.' + newNum;
  items.splice(insertIdx, 0, {
    no: newNo,
    content: '',
    pct: '',
    annualPlan: '',
    cumulative: '',
    pic: '',
    dateStart: '',
    dateEnd: '',
    resources: '',
    note: ''
  });
  // Clean cumulative values: strip any stored % suffix
  items.forEach(function(it){
    if(it.cumulative && typeof it.cumulative === 'string'){
      it.cumulative = it.cumulative.replace(/%/g,'');
    }
  });
  data.planTracking = items;
  saveData();
  renderPlanTracking();
  // Auto-focus the new row's content field so user can type immediately
  setTimeout(function(){
    var newInput = document.querySelector('.plan-input[data-idx="' + insertIdx + '"][data-k="content"]');
    if(newInput){ newInput.focus(); newInput.select(); }
  }, 50);
}

// Delete a plan row
function deletePlanRow(idx, btn){
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  var item = items[idx];
  if(!item) return;
  var isZh = lang==='zh';
  if(!confirm((isZh?'确定删除「':'Delete "') + item.content + (isZh?'」?\n\n注意：所有子项也会被删除。':'"?\n\nAll child items will also be removed.') + '\n\n编号: ' + item.no)) return;
  var no = item.no;
  // Remove this item and all its children
  items = items.filter(function(it){ return !it.no.startsWith(no + '.') && it.no !== no; });
  // Re-number siblings only when deleting a leaf (depth >= 2 = "X.Y.Z"),
  // not when deleting a sub-parent (depth = 1 = "X.Y") — to avoid cross-category corruption.
  var dotCount = (no.match(/\./g) || []).length;
  if(dotCount >= 1){
    var parentNo = no.substring(0, no.lastIndexOf('.'));
    var siblings = items.filter(function(it){ return it.no.startsWith(parentNo + '.') && (it.no.match(/\./g) || []).length === dotCount; });
    siblings.sort(function(a,b){ return a.no.localeCompare(b.no); });
    var counter = 1;
    siblings.forEach(function(sib){
      var oldNo = sib.no;
      var newNo = parentNo + '.' + counter;
      items.forEach(function(it){
        if(it.no === oldNo) it.no = newNo;
        else if(it.no.startsWith(oldNo + '.')) it.no = newNo + it.no.substring(oldNo.length);
      });
      counter++;
    });
  }
  // Clean cumulative values: strip any stored % suffix
  items.forEach(function(it){
    if(it.cumulative && typeof it.cumulative === 'string'){
      it.cumulative = it.cumulative.replace(/%/g,'');
    }
  });
  data.planTracking = items;
  saveData();
  renderPlanTracking();
}

// Add new top-level category
function addNewCategory(){
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  // Find next available letter
  var usedLetters = items.filter(function(it){ return !it.no.includes('.'); }).map(function(it){ return it.no; });
  var nextLetter = '';
  for(var c = 65; c <= 90; c++){ // A-Z
    var letter = String.fromCharCode(c);
    if(usedLetters.indexOf(letter) < 0){ nextLetter = letter; break; }
  }
  if(!nextLetter){
    alert(lang==='zh'?'已达最大类别数':'Maximum categories reached');
    return;
  }
  items.push({
    no: nextLetter,
    content: '',
    pct: '',
    annualPlan: '',
    cumulative: '',
    pic: '',
    resources: '',
    note: '',
    isParent: true
  });
  // Clean cumulative values: strip any stored % suffix
  items.forEach(function(it){
    if(it.cumulative && typeof it.cumulative === 'string'){
      it.cumulative = it.cumulative.replace(/%/g,'');
    }
  });
  data.planTracking = items;
  saveData();
  renderPlanTracking();
  // Auto-focus the new category content field
  setTimeout(function(){
    var catIdx = items.length - 1;
    var newInput = document.querySelector('.plan-input[data-idx="' + catIdx + '"][data-k="content"]');
    if(newInput){ newInput.focus(); newInput.select(); }
  }, 50);
}

var _origSave = window.saveData || function(){};
window.saveData = function(){
  _origSave();
  // Check if logged in via Firebase Auth or simple password
  var isLoggedIn = fauth && fauth.currentUser || localStorage.getItem('bms_logged_in') === '1';
  if(!isLoggedIn) return; // Skip cloud if not logged in

  // ===== Auto Snapshot: archive current cloud version before overwriting =====
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').get().then(function(docSnap){

      // Build readable timestamp: YYYYMMDD_HHmmss, e.g. 20260721_143000
      var d = new Date();
      var pad=function(n){return n<10?'0'+n:''+n;};
      var ts = d.getFullYear()+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+pad(d.getDate())+'_'+pad(d.getHours())+pad(d.getMinutes())+pad(d.getSeconds());
      // Save current cloud data as snapshot (docs auto-sort by ts lexicographically)
      return fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').collection('snapshots').doc(ts).set(docSnap.data());
    }
  }).then(function(){

    return fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').set({ data: data, updatedBy: 'user', updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });
  }).then(function(){
      cloudStatus = 'synced';

// ===== REAL-TIME CLOUD LISTENER =====
var _cloudUnsubscribe = null;
var _isSyncingFromOwnSave = false;

function listenToCloud(){
  // Unsubscribe previous listener if any
  if(_cloudUnsubscribe){
    _cloudUnsubscribe();
    _cloudUnsubscribe = null;
  }
  // Allow both Firebase Auth login and simple password login
  var isLoggedIn = localStorage.getItem('bms_logged_in') === '1';
  if(!isLoggedIn) return;
  
  console.log('[Firebase] Starting real-time listener...');
  
  // Check Firebase is available

    console.error('[Firebase] Firestore not initialized!');
    cloudStatus = 'offline'; updateSyncStatus('⚠️');

  }
  
  cloudStatus = 'synced'; updateSyncStatus('☁️');
  
  _cloudUnsubscribe = fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master')
    .onSnapshot(function(doc){
      console.log('[Firebase] onSnapshot fired, exists:', doc.exists);

      var dataClean = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));

      delete dataClean.weeklyReports; delete fbClean.weeklyReports;

        data = fbData;
        _origSave(); // Save to localStorage
        // NEW: sync docSECTIONS from cloud (if present & valid) so Doc Storage stays in sync across browsers
        try{
          if(Array.isArray(data.docSECTIONS) && data.docSECTIONS.length > 0){

// Show sync status indicator
function updateSyncStatus(icon){
  var el = document.getElementById('cloudStatus');
  if(el) {
    el.textContent = icon;
    if(cloudStatus === 'synced') el.className = 'text-green-500 text-sm';
    else if(cloudStatus === 'loading') el.className = 'text-blue-400 text-sm';
    else el.className = 'text-yellow-400 text-sm';
  }
  // Also update header badge
  var hb = document.getElementById('cloudBadge');
  if(hb) {
    hb.textContent = icon;
    var txt = document.getElementById('cloudBadgeTxt');
    if(cloudStatus === 'synced') {
      hb.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card)] border border-green-500/50 cursor-pointer select-none flex items-center gap-1';
      if(txt) { txt.textContent = 'Cloud'; txt.className = 'text-[10px] text-green-400'; }
    } else if(cloudStatus === 'loading') {
      hb.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card)] border border-blue-500/50 cursor-pointer select-none flex items-center gap-1';
      if(txt) { txt.textContent = 'Loading'; txt.className = 'text-[10px] text-blue-400'; }
    } else {
      hb.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card)] border border-yellow-500/50 cursor-pointer select-none flex items-center gap-1';
      if(txt) { txt.textContent = 'Offline'; txt.className = 'text-[10px] text-yellow-400'; }
    }
  }
}

// Toast notification
function showToast(msg){
  var existing = document.getElementById('cloudToast');
  if(existing) existing.remove();
  var div = document.createElement('div');
  div.id = 'cloudToast';
  div.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--green,#22c55e);color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;z-index:9999;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.3s;';
  div.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(div);
  setTimeout(function(){ div.style.opacity = '1'; }, 50);
  setTimeout(function(){
    div.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(function(){ div.remove(); }, 300);
  }, 2500);
}

// Cloud info popup
function showCloudInfo(){
  var existing = document.getElementById('cloudTooltip');
  if(existing){ existing.remove(); return; }
  var badge = document.getElementById('cloudBadge');
  if(!badge) return;
  var rect = badge.getBoundingClientRect();
  var div = document.createElement('div');
  div.id = 'cloudTooltip';
  div.className = 'cloud-tooltip';
  var statusText = cloudStatus === 'synced' ? '☁️ Connected' : (cloudStatus === 'loading' ? '⏳ Connecting...' : '⚠️ Offline');
  div.innerHTML = '<div class="ctitle">☁️ Cloud Sync</div>' +
    '<div>Status: ' + statusText + '</div>' +
    '<div class="cstatus">Firebase: mgd-bms<br>Storage: Firestore</div>';
  div.style.left = (rect.left - 80) + 'px';
  div.style.top = (rect.bottom + 5) + 'px';
  document.body.appendChild(div);
  // Close on click outside
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', function closeTip(e){
      if(!div.contains(e.target) && e.target.id !== 'cloudBadge'){
        div.remove();
        document.removeEventListener('click', closeTip);
      }
    });
  }, 100);
}

// Canonical fallback registry (immutable copy of the default, 9 sections). Used by the
// anti-shrink guards so a stale/partial local copy can never drop a known section.
const DOC_SECTIONS_FALLBACK = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(docSECTIONS));

// Append any section that exists in the cloud copy or in the canonical fallback but is
// missing locally. Ids the user explicitly deleted (data.docDeletedSections) are skipped,
// so intentional deletions still work while accidental loss is impossible.
function docRestoreMissingSections(){
  try{
    var have={}; docSECTIONS.forEach(function(s){ if(s&&s.id) have[s.id]=true; });
    var deleted = (typeof data!=='undefined' && data && Array.isArray(data.docDeletedSections)) ? data.docDeletedSections : [];
    var pool = [];
    if(typeof data!=='undefined' && data && Array.isArray(data.docSECTIONS)) pool = pool.concat(data.docSECTIONS);
    pool = pool.concat(DOC_SECTIONS_FALLBACK);
    var restored = [];
    pool.forEach(function(s){
      if(!s || !s.id || have[s.id]) return;
      if(deleted.indexOf(s.id) >= 0) return;   // user deleted it on purpose
      docSECTIONS.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s)));
      have[s.id]=true; restored.push(s.id);
    });
    if(restored.length) console.warn('[DocStorage] anti-shrink restored: '+restored.join(', '));
    return restored;
  }catch(e){ console.log('[DocStorage] docRestoreMissingSections error:', e.message); return []; }
}

// section has a label (fall back to id) and a valid subs array, so no
// "undefined" ever shows in the table/dashboard.
function docNormalizeSections(){
  if(!Array.isArray(docSECTIONS)) return;
  var _changed = false;
  docSECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
    if(!sec || typeof sec !== 'object') return;
    if(!sec.label) sec.label = sec.id || 'OTHER';
    if(!Array.isArray(sec.subs)) sec.subs = [];
    sec.subs.forEach(sub => {
      if(!sub || typeof sub !== 'object') return;
      if(!sub.label) sub.label = sub.id || 'General';
      if(!Array.isArray(sub.items)) sub.items = [];
      // Dedupe: drop exact duplicate items (same desc + location) within a sub-section.
      // Fixes "Document Description duplicates" caused by older dual-write bugs.
      var seen = {};
      var _origLen = sub.items.length;
      sub.items = sub.items.filter(function(it){
        if(!it || typeof it !== 'object') return false;
        var key = String(it.desc||'') + '\u0000' + String(it.location||'');
        if(seen[key]) return false;
        seen[key] = true;
        return true;
      });
      if(sub.items.length !== _origLen) _changed = true;
    });
  });
  if(_changed){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('bms_doc_data', JSON.stringify(docSECTIONS)); }catch(e){}
  }
}

function docRebuildAllItems(){
  docAllItems = [];
  docCounter = 1;
  docSECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
    sec.subs.forEach(sub => {
      sub.items.forEach(it => {
        const id = docCounter++;
        it._id = id; // Tag source tree for SaveLocation back-mapping
        it.id = id;  // Unify id system: override stale `id` from legacy dual-write data
        docAllItems.push({
          id, sectionId: sec.id, sectionLabel: sec.label, bgClass: sec.bgClass,
          subsection: sub.label, desc: it.desc, start: it.start, collected: it.collected,
          location: it.location || '', dept: it.dept, remark: ''
        });
      });
    });
  });
}

// ── Inline edit: Document link (4 fixed options) ──
const DOC_LINK_OPTIONS = ['Google Link','One Drive','Drop Box','Local Server'];

// Sync a docAllItems field back to the docSECTIONS source tree
function docSyncSource(id, field, value){
  docSECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
    sec.subs.forEach(sub => {
      sub.items.forEach(src => {
        if(src._id === id){
          src[field] = value;
        }
      });
    });
  });
}

function docEditDept(id, el){
  if(el.querySelector('select')) return; // already editing — prevent re-trigger from click bubbling
  const cur = el.textContent === '—' ? '' : el.textContent;
  // Build a small dropdown in place
  const sel = document.createElement('select');
  sel.style.width = '150px';
  sel.style.fontSize = '12px';
  sel.style.padding = '2px 4px';
  // Keep current value as first option if it's not in the fixed list
  const opts = DOC_LINK_OPTIONS.slice();
  if(cur && !opts.includes(cur)) opts.unshift(cur);
  opts.forEach(o => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = o;
    opt.textContent = o;
    if(o === cur) opt.selected = true;
    sel.appendChild(opt);
  });
  el.textContent = '';
  el.appendChild(sel);
  // Stop propagation so clicking the select doesn't bubble to the span
  // and re-trigger docEditDept (which replaced the dropdown instantly).
  sel.addEventListener('mousedown', e => e.stopPropagation());
  sel.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
  sel.focus();
  const done = (val) => {
    const item = docAllItems.find(i => i.id === id);
    if(item){ item.dept = val; }
    docSyncSource(id, 'dept', val);
    el.textContent = val || '—';
    docPersist();
  };
  sel.onchange = () => { const v = sel.value; done(v); };
  sel.onblur = () => { if(el.querySelector('select')){ const v = sel.value; done(v); } };
  sel.onkeydown = (e) => {
    if(e.key === 'Escape'){ el.textContent = cur || '—'; }
  };
};

function docToast(msg){
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
}

function docRenderTable(){
  const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
  let filtered = docAllItems;
  if(q) filtered = filtered.filter(i => i.desc.toLowerCase().includes(q) || i.sectionId.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  if(docCurrentSection) filtered = filtered.filter(i => i.sectionId === docCurrentSection);
  if(docCurrentFilter === 'collected') filtered = filtered.filter(i => i.collected);
  if(docCurrentFilter === 'pending') filtered = filtered.filter(i => !i.collected);

  docRenderTrackerBody(filtered);
  docRenderDashboard();
  docRenderProgress();
  docUpdateStats();
  const pending = docAllItems.filter(i => !i.collected).length;
  const badge = document.getElementById('sidebarBadge');
  if(badge) badge.textContent = pending + ' left';
}

function docRenderTrackerBody(filtered){
  const tbody = document.getElementById('trackerBody');
  let html = '';
  let rowAlt = false;

  docSECTIONS.forEach((sec, si) => {
    // When a specific section is selected (via top buttons), only render that section's rows
    if(docCurrentSection && sec.id !== docCurrentSection) return;
    const secItems = filtered.filter(i => i.sectionId === sec.id);
    html += `<tr class="section-row s-row-${si % 6}"><td colspan="6">${docSectionName(sec.id)}</td><td class="c del-cell" onclick="docDeleteSection(${si})" title="Delete this section">🗑</td></tr>`;
    if(secItems.length === 0) return;
    // Collect all sub-section labels from data + predefined (preserve order)
    const allSubLabels = [...new Set([
      ...sec.subs.map(s => s.label),
      ...secItems.map(i => i.subsection).filter(Boolean)
    ])];
    allSubLabels.forEach(subLabel => {
      const sub = sec.subs.find(s => s.label === subLabel);
      const subItems = secItems.filter(i => i.subsection === subLabel);
      if(subItems.length === 0) return;
      html += `<tr class="subsection-row"><td colspan="6">▸ ${subLabel}</td><td class="c del-cell" onclick="docDeleteSubsection(${si},'${subLabel.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')" title="Delete this sub-section">🗑</td></tr>`;
      subItems.forEach(it => {
        const rc = rowAlt ? 'row-white' : 'row-gray';
        rowAlt = !rowAlt;
        const done = !!it.collected;
        const hasLoc = !!it.location;
        const sHTML = done ? '<span class="badge-done">✓</span>' : '<span class="badge-pending">○</span>';
        const aHTML = done
          ? `<button class="btn-docUnmark" onclick="docUnmark(${it.id})" title="Unmark">☐ Unmark</button>`
          : `<button class="btn-docMark" onclick="docMark(${it.id})" title="Mark as recorded">☑ Record</button>`;
        const locHTML = hasLoc
          ? `<span class="loc-link" onclick="docOpenLocation(${it.id})" title="${it.location}">📁 ${it.location}</span>`
          : `<span class="loc-empty" onclick="docOpenLocation(${it.id})">+ Set location</span>`;

        html += `<tr class="${rc}"><td></td><td>${it.desc}</td>
          <td>${locHTML}</td>
          <td class="c"><span class="doc-inline-dept" data-id="${it.id}" onclick="docEditDept(${it.id},this)">${it.dept || '—'}</span></td>
          <td class="c">${sHTML}</td>
          <td class="c">${aHTML}</td><td class="c del-cell" onclick="docDeleteDoc(${it.id})" title="Delete this document">🗑</td></tr>`;
      });
    });
  });
  if(!html) html = '<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:#999">No matching items.</td></tr>';
  tbody.innerHTML = html;
}

function docRenderDashboard(){
  const tbody = document.getElementById('dashBody');
  let html = '';
  docSECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
    const items = docAllItems.filter(i => i.sectionId === sec.id);
    const total = items.length;
    const done = items.filter(i => i.collected).length;
    const located = items.filter(i => i.location).length;
    const pending = total - done;
    const pct = total > 0 ? (done/total*100).toFixed(0) + '%' : '0%';
    const secName = docSectionName(sec.id);

    html += `<tr class="${sec.bgClass}">
      <td class="col-section">${secName}</td>
      <td class="col-total">${total}</td>
      <td class="col-data green bold">${done}</td>
      <td class="col-data bold" style="color:#0a6e8a">${located}</td>
      <td class="col-data" style="color:#0a6e8a">${pending}</td>
      <td class="col-data green bold">${pct}</td>
    </tr>`;
  });

  const all = docAllItems;
  const rec = all.filter(i => i.collected).length;
  const l = all.filter(i => i.location).length;
  const p = all.length - rec;
  const tPct = all.length > 0 ? (rec/all.length*100).toFixed(0) + '%' : '0%';
  html += `<tr class="total-row">
    <td class="col-section" style="text-align:center;padding-left:12px">TOTAL</td>
    <td class="col-total">${all.length}</td>
    <td class="col-data green bold">${rec}</td>
    <td class="col-data bold" style="color:#fff">${l}</td>
    <td class="col-data">${p}</td>
    <td class="col-data green bold">${tPct}</td>
  </tr>`;

  tbody.innerHTML = html;
  docRenderPieChart();
}

function docRenderPieChart(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('pieChart');
  if(!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 160, H = 160, cx = 80, cy = 80, R = 68;
  const all = docAllItems;
  const rec = all.filter(i => i.collected).length;
  const pen = all.length - rec;
  const pct = all.length > 0 ? (rec/all.length*100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if(all.length === 0){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8';
    ctx.fill();
    document.getElementById('pieCenterText').textContent = '0 / 0';
    document.getElementById('pieLegend').innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#999">No documents yet</span>';
    return;
  }

  // Recorded slice (green)
  if(rec > 0){
    const sweep = (rec / all.length) * Math.PI * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + sweep);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#28a745';
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // Pending slice (light gray)
  if(pen > 0){
    const startA = -Math.PI/2 + (rec/all.length) * Math.PI * 2;
    const sweep = (pen / all.length) * Math.PI * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, startA, startA + sweep);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e0e0';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Donut hole
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fill();

  document.getElementById('pieCenterText').textContent = rec + ' / ' + pen;
  document.getElementById('pieLegend').innerHTML = `
    <div class="leg-item"><span class="leg-dot" style="background:#28a745"></span> Recorded: <strong>${rec}</strong></div>
    <div class="leg-item"><span class="leg-dot" style="background:#e0e0e0"></span> Pending: <strong>${pen}</strong></div>
    <div class="leg-item" style="color:#555">Completion: <strong>${pct}%</strong></div>
  `;
}
function docRenderProgress(){
  const all = docAllItems;
  const collected = all.filter(i => i.collected).length;
  const located = all.filter(i => i.location).length;
  const total = all.length;
  const pct = total > 0 ? collected/total : 0;
  const blocks = Math.round(pct * 20);
  const bar = '█'.repeat(blocks) + '░'.repeat(20 - blocks);
  const depts = new Set(all.filter(i => i.dept).map(i => i.dept));
  document.getElementById('progressBarText').textContent = bar + '  ' + (pct*100).toFixed(0) + '%';
  document.getElementById('prTotal').textContent = total;
  document.getElementById('prCollected').textContent = collected;
  document.getElementById('prLoc').textContent = located;
  document.getElementById('prPending').textContent = total - collected;
  document.getElementById('prDept').textContent = depts.size;
  document.getElementById('prPct').textContent = (pct*100).toFixed(1) + '%';
}

function docUpdateStats(){
  const total = docAllItems.length;
  const collected = docAllItems.filter(i => i.collected).length;
  const located = docAllItems.filter(i => i.location).length;
}

function docMark(id){
  const item = docAllItems.find(i => i.id === id);
  if(!item) return;
  const newVal = item.collected ? '' : '✓';
  item.collected = newVal;
  docSyncSource(id, 'collected', newVal);
  if(newVal && !item.location) {
    setTimeout(() => docOpenLocation(id), 100);
    docToast('✓ Recorded! Now set the document location.');
  } else if(newVal) {
    docToast('✓ Document recorded');
  } else {
    docToast('↩ Unmarked');
  }
  docPersist();
  docRenderTable();
}

function docUnmark(id){
  const item = docAllItems.find(i => i.id === id);
  if(!item) return;
  item.collected = '';
  docSyncSource(id, 'collected', '');
  docPersist();
  docRenderTable();
}

function docOpenLocation(id){
  const item = docAllItems.find(i => i.id === id);
  if(!item) return;
  docEditingLocId = id;
  document.getElementById('locDocName').value = item.desc;
  document.getElementById('locInput').value = item.location || '';
  document.getElementById('locModal').classList.add('open');
}

function docCloseLocModal(){
  document.getElementById('locModal').classList.remove('open');
  docEditingLocId = null;
}

function docSetLocQuick(val){
  const input = document.getElementById('locInput');
  input.value = input.value + val;
  input.focus();
}

function docSaveLocation(){
  if(!docEditingLocId) return;
  const item = docAllItems.find(i => i.id === docEditingLocId);
  if(!item) return;
  const loc = document.getElementById('locInput').value.trim();
  const newDesc = document.getElementById('locDocName').value.trim();
  if(newDesc) item.desc = newDesc;
  item.location = loc;
  // Also update the source tree (docSECTIONS) so docPersist() writes correct data
  docSECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
    sec.subs.forEach(sub => {
      sub.items.forEach(src => {
        if(src._id === item.id){
          if(newDesc) src.desc = newDesc;
          src.location = loc;
          if(loc && !src.collected) src.collected = '\u2713';
        }
      });
    });
  });
  if(loc && !item.collected) {
    item.collected = '✓';
    docToast('📁 Location saved & auto-recorded ✓');
  } else if(loc) {
    docToast('📁 Location saved');
  } else {
    docToast('Location cleared');
  }
  docPersist();
  docCloseLocModal();
  docRenderTable();
}

function docSetFilter(f){

function removeAccents(str){
  return String(str||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/đ/g,'d').replace(/Đ/g,'D');
}

function docSaveSection(){
  const name = document.getElementById('f_secName').value.trim();
  if(!name){ alert('Please enter section name.'); return; }
  const cleanName = name.replace(/^\s*\d+\.?\s*/, '').trim();
  const subsRaw = document.getElementById('f_secSubs').value.trim();
  let subs;
  if(subsRaw){
    subs = subsRaw.split('\n').filter(s=>s.trim()).map(s => ({label:s.trim(), items:[{desc:'New document', start:'', collected:'', location:'', dept:''}]}));
  } else {
    subs = [{label:'A. Default', items:[{desc:'New document', start:'', collected:'', location:'', dept:''}]}];
  }
  const secNum = docSECTIONS.length + 1;
  const newId = secNum + '. ' + removeAccents(cleanName).toUpperCase();
  const bgClasses = ['bg-row1','bg-row2','bg-row3','bg-row4','bg-row5','bg-row6'];
  const bgClass = bgClasses[(docSECTIONS.length) % 6];
  docSECTIONS.push({id:newId, label:newId, totalItems:1, bgClass, subs});
  try{ if(Array.isArray(data.docDeletedSections)){ data.docDeletedSections = data.docDeletedSections.filter(function(x){return x!==newId;}); } }catch(e){}
  docRebuildAllItems();
  docBuildSectionBtns();
  docCloseSectionModal();
  docRenderTable();
  docPersist();
  docToast('📂 New section added: ' + newId);
}
