function docEditSelectedSub(){
  const secId = document.getElementById('f_section').value;
  const sel = document.getElementById('f_subsection');
  const curVal = sel.value;
  if(!secId){ alert('Please select a section first.'); return; }
  const sec = docSECTIONS.find(s => s.id === secId);
  if(!sec){ alert('Section not found.'); return; }
  // Determine which sub-section to edit: selected option, or custom input value
  let subLabel = curVal;
  if(!subLabel || subLabel === '__new__'){
    const inp = document.getElementById('f_subsection_new');
    subLabel = inp.value.trim();
  }
  if(!subLabel){ alert('Please select or type a sub-section first.'); return; }
  const sub = sec.subs.find(s => s.label === subLabel);
  if(!sub){ alert('Sub-section "' + subLabel + '" not found in this section.'); return; }
  document.getElementById('subEditSec').value = docSectionName(sec.id);
  document.getElementById('subEditSec').dataset.oldLabel = subLabel;
  document.getElementById('subEditName').value = subLabel;
  document.getElementById('subEditModal').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('subEditName').select(), 100);
}

function docCloseSubEditModal(){
  document.getElementById('subEditModal').classList.remove('open');
}

function docSaveSubEdit(){
  const secId = document.getElementById('f_section').value;
  const newLabel = document.getElementById('subEditName').value.trim();
  const oldLabel = document.getElementById('subEditSec').dataset.oldLabel || '';
  if(!newLabel){ alert('Please enter a sub-section name.'); return; }
  if(!oldLabel){ alert('Missing original sub-section name.'); return; }
  const sec = docSECTIONS.find(s => s.id === secId);
  if(!sec){ alert('Section not found.'); return; }
  const sub = sec.subs.find(s => s.label === oldLabel);
  if(!sub){ alert('Sub-section not found.'); return; }
  if(newLabel !== oldLabel && sec.subs.some(s => s.label === newLabel)){
    alert('Sub-section "' + newLabel + '" already exists in this section.');
    return;
  }
  sub.label = newLabel;
  docCloseSubEditModal();
  docCloseModal();
  docRebuildAllItems();
  docRenderTable();
  docPersist();
  docToast('✏️ Sub-section renamed: ' + oldLabel + ' → ' + newLabel);
}

// Delete the section currently selected in the Add Document modal
function docDeleteSelectedSection(){
  const secId = document.getElementById('f_section').value;
  if(!secId){ alert('Please select a section first.'); return; }
  const si = docSECTIONS.findIndex(s => s.id === secId);
  if(si < 0){ alert('Section not found.'); return; }
  const sec = docSECTIONS[si];
  const itemCount = sec.subs ? sec.subs.reduce((n,sub)=>n+(sub.items?sub.items.length:0),0) : 0;
  if(!confirm('Delete section "' + docSectionName(sec.id) + '"' + (itemCount>0 ? ' and its '+itemCount+' document(s)' : '') + '?')) return;
  try{ if(!Array.isArray(data.docDeletedSections)) data.docDeletedSections=[]; if(data.docDeletedSections.indexOf(sec.id)<0) data.docDeletedSections.push(sec.id); }catch(e){}
  docSECTIONS.splice(si, 1);
  delete data.docItems;
  docRebuildAllItems();
  docBuildSectionBtns();
  docRenderTable();
  // Re-populate the dropdown + close modal if it becomes empty
  docPopulateSubs();
  docCloseModal();
  docPersist();
  docToast('🗑 Deleted section: ' + docSectionName(sec.id));
}

// ── Delete Section / Sub-Section / Document ──
function docDeleteSection(si){
  const sec = docSECTIONS[si];
  if(!confirm('Delete section "' + docSectionName(sec.id) + '" and all its documents?')) return;
  try{ if(!Array.isArray(data.docDeletedSections)) data.docDeletedSections=[]; if(data.docDeletedSections.indexOf(sec.id)<0) data.docDeletedSections.push(sec.id); }catch(e){}
  docSECTIONS.splice(si, 1);
  delete data.docItems;
  docRebuildAllItems();
  docBuildSectionBtns();
  docRenderTable();
  docPersist();
  docToast('🗑 Deleted section: ' + docSectionName(sec.id));
}

function docDeleteSubsection(si, subKey){
  const sec = docSECTIONS[si];
  // subKey is now a label string, find it in predefined subs
  const subIdx = sec.subs.findIndex(s => s.label === subKey);
  const sub = subIdx >= 0 ? sec.subs[subIdx] : {label: subKey};
  if(!confirm('Delete sub-section "' + subKey + '" and all its documents?')) return;
  // Remove from predefined subs if it exists there
  if(subIdx >= 0) sec.subs.splice(subIdx, 1);
  delete data.docItems;
  docRebuildAllItems();
  docRenderTable();
  docPersist();
  docToast('🗑 Deleted: ' + sub.label);
}

function docDeleteDoc(id){
  const item = docAllItems.find(i => i.id === id);
  if(!item) return;
  if(!confirm('Delete document "' + item.desc + '"?')) return;
  // Remove from docSECTIONS data structure
  docSECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
    sec.subs.forEach(sub => {
      const idx = sub.items.findIndex(it => it.desc === item.desc && it.location === item.location);
      if(idx !== -1) sub.items.splice(idx, 1);
    });
  });
  delete data.docItems;
  docRebuildAllItems();
  docRenderTable();
  docPersist();
  docToast('🗑 Deleted: ' + item.desc);
}

function docGetSubSectionValue(){
  const sel = document.getElementById('f_subsection');
  const inp = document.getElementById('f_subsection_new');
  if(sel.style.display === 'none' || sel.style.display === ''){
    return inp.value.trim();
  }
  const v = sel.value;
  return (v === '__new__' || v === '') ? '' : v;
}

function docOpenModal(){
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = '➕ Add / Record Document';
  const secSel = document.getElementById('f_section');
  secSel.innerHTML = docSECTIONS.map(s => `<option value="${s.id}">${docSectionName(s.id)}</option>`).join('');
  // Clear inputs
  document.getElementById('f_subsection_new').value = '';
  document.getElementById('f_subsection_new').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('f_subsection').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('f_desc').value = '';
  document.getElementById('f_location').value = '';
  // Populate Sub-Section dropdown
  docPopulateSubs();
  document.getElementById('addModal').classList.add('open');
  // Auto-focus description
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('f_desc').focus(), 100);
}

function docCloseModal(){
  document.getElementById('addModal').classList.remove('open');
  var m2 = document.getElementById('addSectionModal');
  if(m2) m2.classList.remove('open');
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.key==='Escape'){
    document.getElementById('addModal').classList.remove('open');
    var m2 = document.getElementById('addSectionModal');
    if(m2) m2.classList.remove('open');
    var m3 = document.getElementById('subEditModal');
    if(m3) m3.classList.remove('open');
  }
});

function docPersist(){
  // ANTI-SHRINK GUARD: never let a registry that is MISSING sections overwrite a richer one.
  // Sections 7/8/9 (FORMS/PROFILE/DESIGN) were lost exactly this way on 2026-09-11.
  if(typeof docRestoreMissingSections==='function') docRestoreMissingSections();
  // Save to independent key (local)
  localStorage.setItem('bms_doc_data', JSON.stringify(docSECTIONS));
  if(typeof window.dcCloudPush==='function') window.dcCloudPush();
  // NEW: also sync docSECTIONS to Firestore via data.docSECTIONS (reuses saveData cloud pipeline)
  try{
    data.docSECTIONS = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(docSECTIONS));
    if(typeof saveData === 'function') saveData();
  }catch(e){ console.log('[DocStorage] cloud sync error:', e.message); }
}

function docSaveItem(keepOpen){if(keepOpen===undefined)keepOpen=true;
  const desc = document.getElementById('f_desc').value.trim();
  if(!desc){ alert('Please enter a document description.'); return; }
  const secId = document.getElementById('f_section').value;
  const sec = docSECTIONS.find(s => s.id === secId);
  const bg = sec?.bgClass || 'bg-row1';
  const subLabel = docGetSubSectionValue();
  const loc = document.getElementById('f_location').value || '';
  const id = ++docCounter;
  // Ensure sub-section exists in docSECTIONS tree (for rebuild + delete)
  if(sec && subLabel){
    let sub = sec.subs.find(s => s.label === subLabel);
    if(!sub){
      sub = {label: subLabel, items: []};
      sec.subs.push(sub);
    }
    sub.items.push({id, _id:id, desc, start:'', collected:'', location:loc, dept:'', remark:''});
  }
  docAllItems.push({id, sectionId:secId, sectionLabel:secId, bgClass:bg,
    subsection:subLabel, desc, start:'', collected:'', location:loc, dept:'', remark:''});
  docToast('✅ ' + desc + ' added');
  docPersist();
  if(keepOpen){
    document.getElementById('f_desc').value = '';
    document.getElementById('f_location').value = '';
    document.getElementById('f_desc').focus();
    // Refresh Sub-Section dropdown, re-select the one just used
    docPopulateSubs();
    if(subLabel){
      const subSel = document.getElementById('f_subsection');
      if([...subSel.options].some(o => o.value === subLabel)){
        subSel.value = subLabel;
      } else {
        // Custom sub-section: show custom input
        document.getElementById('f_subsection').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('f_subsection_new').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('f_subsection_new').value = subLabel;
      }
    }
    docRenderTable();
  } else {
    docCloseModal();
    docRenderTable();
  }
}

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  DATA — Simulates Phase 1 fully-registered documents
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  DATA — reads REAL registry from BMS (localStorage bms_doc_data)
//  Only documents that are FULLY confirmed (collected ✓ + location set)
//  are available for picking.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function getDocs(){
  var out = [];
  // Prefer in-memory docSECTIONS (real-time, includes latest Document link/dept changes)
  var tree = null;
  try{
    if(typeof docSECTIONS !== 'undefined' && docSECTIONS && docSECTIONS.length){
      tree = docSECTIONS;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  if(!tree){
    try{
      var raw = localStorage.getItem('bms_doc_data');
      tree = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if(tree && tree.length){
    var cid = 0;
    tree.forEach(function(sec){
      if(!sec || !sec.subs) return;
      sec.subs.forEach(function(sub){
        if(!sub || !sub.items) return;
        sub.items.forEach(function(it){
          if(!it) return;
          // Filter: only fully confirmed docs (collected ✓ + location set)
          if(!it.collected || !it.location) return;
          cid++;
          out.push({
            id: 'r' + cid,
            theme: docSectionName(sec.id),
            subSection: sub.label || 'General',
            desc: it.desc || '',
            loc: it.location || '',
            source: it.dept || (it.location ? 'Local' : ''),
            link: it.location || ''
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }
  if(!out.length){
    // Fallback: empty state message handled by renderList
  }
  return out;
}

// All sections registered in Documentation Storage (regardless of confirmed
// status) — THEMES sidebar must mirror the full section list.
// count = total registered items under that section (live count).
function getAllSections(){
  var secs = [];
  try{
    var raw = localStorage.getItem('bms_doc_data');
    var tree = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    if(tree && tree.length){
      tree.forEach(function(sec){
        if(!sec) return;
        var n = 0;
        if(sec.subs){
          sec.subs.forEach(function(sub){
            if(sub && sub.items){
              sub.items.forEach(function(it){
                // Only count fully confirmed docs (collected ✓ + location set)
                if(it && it.collected && it.location) n++;
              });
            }
          });
        }
        // Skip sections with nothing confirmed yet — no count, no row
        if(n > 0) secs.push({ id: sec.id, label: docSectionName(sec.id), count: n });
      });
    }
  }catch(e){ console.warn('[dc] getAllSections failed:', e); }
  return secs;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CLOUD SYNC — Documents Collection data lives in Firestore so it
//  is shared across browsers (Firefox/Chrome/mobile). localStorage is
//  kept as a cache/offline fallback.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const DC_CLOUD_DOC = 'doc_dc';
let _dcCloudLoaded = false;
let _dcCloudTimer = null;
let _dcCloudUnsub = null;

// Upload local data to the cloud (debounced). Called whenever
// members/state changes on this browser.
function dcCloudPush(){
  if(!_dcCloudLoaded || typeof fdb === 'undefined') return;
  clearTimeout(_dcCloudTimer);
  _dcCloudTimer = setTimeout(function(){
    var payload = {
      members: (typeof members!=='undefined') ? members : [],
      state: { cart: cart||[], pickHistory: pickHistory||[] },
      docData: (function(){
        try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bms_doc_data')||'null'); }
        catch(e){ return null; }
      })(),
      updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      updatedBy: (typeof verifiedUser!=='undefined'&&verifiedUser) ? verifiedUser : 'browser'
    };
    fdb.collection('bms_data').doc(DC_CLOUD_DOC).set(payload)
      .then(function(){ console.log('[dc] cloud push ok'); })
      .catch(function(e){ console.warn('[dc] cloud push failed:', e); });
  }, 400);
}

// Pull cloud data → merge into local state (cloud wins when present).
function dcCloudLoad(){
  if(typeof fdb === 'undefined') return;
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc(DC_CLOUD_DOC).get().then(function(docSnap){
    if(!docSnap.exists){ _dcCloudLoaded = true; dcCloudPush(); return; }
    var d = docSnap.data() || {};
    _dcCloudLoaded = true;
    // Members (cloud wins)
    if(Array.isArray(d.members) && d.members.length){
      members = d.members;
      try{ localStorage.setItem(MEMBERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(members)); }catch(e){}
    }
    // Cart & history (cloud wins)
    if(d.state){
      if(Array.isArray(d.state.cart)) cart = d.state.cart;
      if(Array.isArray(d.state.pickHistory) && d.state.pickHistory.length) pickHistory = d.state.pickHistory;
      try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({ cart: cart, pickHistory: pickHistory })); }catch(e){}
    }
    // Doc registry (cloud wins)
    if(Array.isArray(d.docData)){
      try{ localStorage.setItem('bms_doc_data', JSON.stringify(d.docData)); }catch(e){}
    }
    // Re-render everything now that cloud data is in
    try{
      if(typeof renderFilter==='function') renderFilter();
      if(typeof renderList==='function') renderList();
      if(typeof renderCart==='function') renderCart();
      if(typeof renderStats==='function') renderStats();
      if(typeof renderOperator==='function') renderOperator();
    }catch(e){ console.warn('[dc] re-render after cloud load:', e); }
    console.log('[dc] cloud loaded:', JSON.stringify({m:d.members&&d.members.length, c:cart.length, h:pickHistory.length, doc:Array.isArray(d.docData)?d.docData.length:0}));
  }).catch(function(e){ console.warn('[dc] cloud load failed (offline?):', e); _dcCloudLoaded = true; });

  // Also live-listen so another browser's change appears here automatically.
  if(_dcCloudUnsub) _dcCloudUnsub();
  _dcCloudUnsub = fdb.collection('bms_data').doc(DC_CLOUD_DOC)
    .onSnapshot(function(doc){
      if(!_dcCloudLoaded || !doc.exists) return;
      var d = doc.data() || {};
      if(Array.isArray(d.members)){
        members = d.members;
        try{ localStorage.setItem(MEMBERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(members)); }catch(e){}
        if(typeof renderOperator==='function') renderOperator();
        if(typeof renderAdminManage==='function') renderAdminManage();
      }
      if(d.state){
        if(Array.isArray(d.state.cart)) cart = d.state.cart;
        if(Array.isArray(d.state.pickHistory) && d.state.pickHistory.length) pickHistory = d.state.pickHistory;
        try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({ cart: cart, pickHistory: pickHistory })); }catch(e){}
        if(typeof renderCart==='function') renderCart();
        if(typeof renderHistory==='function') renderHistory();
        if(typeof renderStats==='function') renderStats();
      }
      if(Array.isArray(d.docData)){
        try{ localStorage.setItem('bms_doc_data', JSON.stringify(d.docData)); }catch(e){}
      }
    });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  MEMBERS & PIN (admin-managed, persisted)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const MEMBERS_KEY = 'shopping_mode_v2_members';
let members = loadMembers();
let verifiedUser = null;      // name verified this session
let resettingName = null;     // which member is in "reset PIN" mode

function defaultMembers(){
  return [
    { name:'Tony',  pin:'', role:'admin'  },
    { name:'Quoc',  pin:'', role:'member' },
    { name:'Huong', pin:'', role:'member' }
  ];
}
function loadMembers(){
  try {
    const m = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MEMBERS_KEY));
    if (Array.isArray(m) && m.length) return m;
  } catch(e){}
  return defaultMembers();
}

function renderList(){
  const el = document.getElementById('docList');
  const allDocs = getDocs();
  const themes = [...new Set(allDocs.map(d=>d.theme))].filter(t=> (filterTheme==='all' || t===filterTheme));

  if(!themes.length){ el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">📭 No documents</div>'; document.getElementById('matchCount').textContent=''; return; }

  let html='', matched=0;
  themes.forEach(theme=>{
    const tdocs = allDocs.filter(d=>d.theme===theme);
    const subs = [...new Set(tdocs.map(d=>d.subSection))];
    const open = collapsed[theme]!==false;
    const themeVisible = tdocs.some(matchesQuery);
    if(!themeVisible) return;

    html += `<div class="theme-row" onclick="dcToggleTheme('${theme}')">
      <span class="arrow ${open?'open':''}">▶</span><span>📂 ${theme}</span>
      <span class="tc">${tdocs.length} docs</span></div>`;
    if(!open) return;

    subs.forEach(sub=>{
      const subDocs = tdocs.filter(d=>d.subSection===sub && matchesQuery(d));
      if(!subDocs.length) return;
      const subKey = theme+'::'+sub;
      const subOpen = collapsedSub[subKey]!==false;
      html += `<div class="subsec-title" onclick="event.stopPropagation();dcToggleSub('${theme}','${sub}')">
        <span class="arrow ${subOpen?'open':''}">▶</span>📁 ${sub}
        <span class="sub-cnt">${subDocs.length}</span></div>`;
      if(!subOpen) return;
      subDocs.forEach(d=>{
        matched++;
        const inCart = cart.some(c=>c.id===d.id);
        html += `<div class="doc-row">
          <button class="add ${inCart?'added':''}" onclick="dcToggleCart('${d.id}')">${inCart?'✓':'+'}</button>
          <span class="dd">${d.desc}</span><span class="dl">📍 ${d.loc}</span><span class="ds">${d.source}</span>
        </div>`;
      });
    });
  });

  el.innerHTML = html || '<div class="empty">🔍 No results for your search</div>';
  document.getElementById('matchCount').textContent = matched ? `${matched} shown` : '';
}

function toggleTheme(t){ collapsed[t] = collapsed[t]===false ? true : false; renderList(); }

const collapsedSub = {};
function toggleSub(theme, sub){
  const k = theme+'::'+sub;
  collapsedSub[k] = collapsedSub[k]===false ? true : false;
  renderList();
}

    if(sel.value){ promptPin(sel.value); } else { sel.focus(); }

  let added = false;
  if(i>=0){ cart.splice(i,1); }
  else {
    const d = getDocs().find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(d){ cart.push({...d}); added = true; }

  const btn = event && event.target && event.target.classList ? event.target : null;
  if(btn && btn.classList){
    btn.classList.remove('pop'); void btn.offsetWidth; btn.classList.add('pop');
  }
  const d = getDocs().find(x=>x.id===id);
  showToast(added
    ? { title:'✓ Added to cart', body: d ? d.desc : '', cls:'' }
    : { title:'Removed from cart', body: d ? d.desc : '', cls:'remove' }
  );
  renderList(); renderCart(); renderStats(); saveState();
}

function openDownloadModal(items){
  dlItems = items.slice();

  // Group by FOLDER: if user typed a global folder name (abc), all files go under it; otherwise group by theme.
  const groups={};
  items.forEach(c=>{ const k = c.fname || c.theme || 'Other'; (groups[k]=groups[k]||[]).push(c); });

  const body = document.getElementById('downloadModalBody');

  let h = `<div class="result-hint">🔗 <b>Google Drive</b> files auto-download when you press Auto Download. <b>OneDrive</b> links need your Microsoft sign-in — click each link to download them manually (then press Auto Download to bundle the Google Drive files).</div>`;
  h += `<h3>📡 DOWNLOAD LIST · by folder</h3>`;
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(k=>{
    const folder = groups[k][0].fname || k;
    h += `<div class="src-g"><div class="src-label">📂 ${folder}</div>`;
    groups[k].forEach(d=>{
      const dl = toDlUrl(d.link);
      h += `<div class="src-item"><span class="dl-icon">⬇️</span><span class="dl-desc">${d.desc}</span><a class="dl-link" href="${dl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Download: ${d.desc}">${dl}</a></div>`;
    });
    h += `</div>`;
  });
  body.innerHTML = h;
  btns.innerHTML = '<button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="dcCancelDownload()">Cancel</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="dcManualDownload()">⬇️ 逐条手动点</button><button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="dcConfirmDownload()">📥 Auto Download All</button>';
  document.getElementById('downloadModal').classList.add('show');
}

function toDlUrl(u){
  // Convert a Google Drive share link to a direct download URL if possible.
  const m = u && u.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([\w-]+)/);
  if(m) return 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id='+m[1];
  // OneDrive: append download=1 so the share page triggers a download instead of opening the viewer.
  if(u && /1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|onedrive\.com/.test(u)){
    const sep = u.indexOf('?') > -1 ? '&' : '?';
    // Strip any existing download param, then add our own.
    let base = u.replace(/[?&]download=1/g, '');
    return base + sep + 'download=1';
  }
  return u;
}

function confirmDownload(){
  if(dlAutoDownloading || !dlItems.length) return;
  dlAutoDownloading = true;
  const items = dlItems.slice();
  // 方案A：只自动下载 Google Drive 文件；OneDrive 链接需用户逐个点开下载（微软会话验证，无法绕过）
  const odRe = /1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|onedrive\.com/;
  const autoItems = items.filter(d=>!odRe.test(d.link||''));
  const odItems = items.filter(d=>odRe.test(d.link||''));
  let idx = 0;
  if(autoItems.length){
    showToast({ title:'📥 Auto-downloading Google Drive files…', body:`${autoItems.length} GD file(s) downloading now; OneDrive file(s) — click links to download manually.`, cls:'' });
  } else {
    showToast({ title:'📥 No Google Drive files', body:`${odItems.length} OneDrive file(s) — click each link above to download.`, cls:'' });
  }
  function next(){
    if(idx >= autoItems.length){
      dlAutoDownloading = false;
      if(odItems.length){
        showToast({ title:'✅ GD files saved', body:`${autoItems.length} Google Drive file(s) saved · ${odItems.length} OneDrive file(s): click the 🔗 links in the list to download them.`, cls:'' });
      } else {
        showToast({ title:'✅ Done', body:`Saved ${autoItems.length} file(s) to your downloads.`, cls:'' });
      }
      return;
    }
    const d = autoItems[idx];
    const u = toDlUrl(d.link);
    try{
      // Google Drive blocks fetch() from browsers (net::ERR_FAILED), so we
      // trigger downloads natively with <a>. Do NOT set the download attribute:
      // it is ignored cross-origin and Drive's Content-Disposition keeps the
      // original file name. Space clicks ~1.5s apart so Chrome does not treat
      // them as a batch and silently drop any file.
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = u;
      a.target = '_self';
      a.rel = 'noopener';
      a.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      idx++;
      showToast({ title:'📥 Downloading', body:`(${idx}/${autoItems.length}) ${d.desc || d.link}`, cls:'' });
    }catch(e){
      console.error('Auto-download click failed:', d.desc, e);
      idx++;
    }
    setTimeout(next, 2000);
  }
  next();
}

  const m = (u||'').match(/\.([A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})(?:[?#]|$)/);

function pfuNorm(s){return String(s==null?'':s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');}
function pfuMatchBid(name){
  var n=pfuNorm(name); if(n.length<3)return null;
  var best=null,bestScore=0;
  (data.bids||[]).forEach(function(b){
    [[b.projectName,3],[b.customerName,2]].forEach(function(pr){
      var t=pfuNorm(pr[0]); if(t.length<3)return;
      var score=0;
      if(t===n)score=100;
      else if(t.indexOf(n)===0||n.indexOf(t)===0)score=80;
      else if(t.indexOf(n)>-1||n.indexOf(t)>-1)score=60;
      if(score)score+=pr[1]+Math.min(10,Math.floor(t.length/6));
      if(score>bestScore){bestScore=score;best=b;}
    });
  });
  return best;
}
function pfuIsBlank(v){v=String(v==null?'':v).trim();return v===''||v==='—'||v==='-';}
function pfuFmtMoney(v){
  var s=String(v==null?'':v).trim(); if(!s||/[a-zA-Z]/.test(s))return s;
  var num=parseFloat(s.replace(/,/g,'')); if(!isFinite(num))return s;
  if(num>=1e9){var b=Math.round(num/1e8)/10;return (b%1?b.toFixed(1):b)+'B VND';}
  if(num>=1e6){var m=Math.round(num/1e5)/10;return (m%1?m.toFixed(1):m)+'M VND';}
  return num.toLocaleString('en-US')+' VND';
}
function pfuFmtArea(v){
  var s=String(v==null?'':v).trim(); if(!s||/[a-zA-Z²]/.test(s))return s;
  var num=parseFloat(s.replace(/,/g,'')); if(!isFinite(num))return s;
  return num.toLocaleString('en-US')+' m²';
}
function pfuFmtDate(v){
  var s=String(v==null?'':v).trim(); if(!s)return s;
  var m=s.match(/^([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})/);
  if(m){var mo=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];return m[3]+' '+mo[parseInt(m[2],10)-1]+' '+m[1];}
  return s;
}

function pfuToISO(v){
  if(v==null)return '';
  v=String(v).trim();
  if(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/.test(v))return v;
  var m=v.match(/^([0-9]{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]{3,})\.?\s*([0-9]{4})?$/);
  if(m){
    var mo=['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'].indexOf(m[2].slice(0,3).toLowerCase());
    if(mo>=0){var y=m[3]||new Date().getFullYear();return y+'-'+('0'+(mo+1)).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+parseInt(m[1],10)).slice(-2);}
  }
  return '';
}

/* ---- per-stage records helpers ---- */
function pfuEnsureStageStatus(p){
  if(!p||typeof p!=='object')return false;
  if(!p.stageStatus||typeof p.stageStatus!=='object'||Array.isArray(p.stageStatus))p.stageStatus={};
  var cur=PFU_STAGES.indexOf(p.stage); if(cur<0)cur=0;
  var changed=false;
  PFU_STAGES.forEach(function(s,i){
    if(p.stageStatus[s]!=='Completed'&&p.stageStatus[s]!=='In Progress'&&p.stageStatus[s]!=='Pending'){
      p.stageStatus[s]=(i<cur?'Completed':(i===cur?'In Progress':'Pending')); changed=true;
    }
  });
  if(!p.stageDone||typeof p.stageDone!=='object'||Array.isArray(p.stageDone))p.stageDone={};
  return changed;
}
function pfuProgress(p){
  pfuEnsureStageStatus(p);
  var done=0; PFU_STAGES.forEach(function(s){ if(p.stageStatus[s]==='Completed')done++; });
  return Math.round(done/PFU_STAGES.length*100);
}
function pfuFinalizeStage(){
  pfuCollect();
  var p=pfuCur(); if(!p)return;
  var cur=PFU_STAGES.indexOf(p.stage); if(cur<0)cur=0;
  var name=PFU_STAGES[cur];
  pfuEnsureStageStatus(p);
  var already=(p.stageStatus[name]==='Completed');
  var next=(cur<PFU_STAGES.length-1)?PFU_STAGES[cur+1]:null;
  var msg=already
    ? ('Stage '+(cur+1)+' \u00b7 '+name+' is already completed.'+(next?' Move on to stage '+(cur+2)+' \u00b7 '+next+' ?':' This is the final stage.'))
    : ('Finalize stage '+(cur+1)+' \u00b7 '+name+' ?\n\nAll records of this stage are KEPT (tasks + notes stay). '+(next?'Then the page moves on to stage '+(cur+2)+' \u00b7 '+next+'.':'This is the final stage.'));
  if(!window.confirm(msg))return;
  p.stageStatus[name]='Completed';
  p.stageDone[name]=pfuNow();
  if(!Array.isArray(p.log))p.log=[];
  p.log.unshift({date:pfuNow(),type:'g',stage:name,title:'Stage '+(cur+1)+' \u00b7 '+name+' finalized',note:'All records kept.'+(next?' Advanced to stage '+(cur+2)+' \u00b7 '+next+'.':'')});
  if(next){
    p.stage=next; p.badge=next; p.badgeCls=PFU_STAGE_CLS[next]||'b';
    if(p.stageStatus[next]==='Pending')p.stageStatus[next]='In Progress';
  }
  p.progress=pfuProgress(p);
  pfuBumpToTop(p);
  if(typeof saveData==='function')saveData();
  pfuRenderAll();
  pfuToast('\u2705 Stage '+(cur+1)+' finalized \u2014 records kept');
}

function craSetSel(id,v,def){var e=craEl(id);if(!e)return;var want=(v==null||v==='')?def:v;var ok=false;for(var i=0;i<e.options.length;i++){if(e.options[i].value===want||e.options[i].text===want){e.selectedIndex=i;ok=true;break;}}if(!ok)e.selectedIndex=0;}
function craAll(){var a=[];CRA_GROUPS.forEach(function(g){g.items.forEach(function(x){a.push(x);});});return a;}
function craIssueLabel(id){var f=craAll().filter(function(x){return x.id===id;});return f.length?(f[0].ic+' '+f[0].n):'';}
function craChips(){
  var el=craEl('cra_groups'); if(!el)return;
  var h='';
  CRA_GROUPS.forEach(function(g){
    h+='<div class="can-grp">'+g.g+'</div><div class="can-chips">';

    });

  });

        <div><label>Project</label><input type="text" id="cra_proj" readonly=""></div>
        <div><label>Cancel Date</label><input type="date" id="cra_date"></div>
        <div><label>Notified by</label><select id="cra_notify"><option>Email (formal)</option><option>Formal letter</option><option>Phone / verbal</option><option>Tender platform notice</option><option>Not notified</option></select></div>
        <div><label>Cancel Stage</label><select id="cra_stage"><option>Result (final)</option><option>Negotiation</option><option>Bidding</option><option>Reviewing</option><option>PQ</option><option>Project Info collection</option></select></div>
        <div><label>Est. value lost (VND)</label><input type="text" id="cra_value"></div>
        <div><label>Area (m²)</label><input type="text" id="cra_area"></div>
        <div><label>PIC</label><input type="text" id="cra_pic"></div>
        <div><label>Is it really dead?</label><select id="cra_dead"><option>Yes — dropped</option><option>No — only postponed</option><option>Unsure</option></select></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="can-card">
      <div class="can-sec">🎯 B · Reason for cancellation <span class="n">— tick any · the FIRST tick becomes the main reason (statistics)</span></div>
      <div id="cra_groups"></div>
      <div class="can-hint" id="cra_mainhint" style="margin-top:7px"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="can-card">
      <div class="can-sec">📝 C · What happened <span class="n">— facts, not opinions</span></div>
      <textarea id="cra_notes" placeholder="e.g. Owner confirmed extension work only — main factory already built by another contractor. Budget for phase 2 not approved this year."></textarea>
    </div>
    <div class="can-card">
      <div class="can-sec">💰 D · Money & claims</div>
      <div class="can-grid can-g4">
        <div><label>Costs incurred so far (VND)</label><input type="text" id="cra_cost" placeholder="0"></div>
        <div><label>Advance / claim</label><select id="cra_claim"><option>None</option><option>Advance received — must return</option><option>Claim submitted</option><option>To be checked</option></select></div>
        <div><label>Loss of opportunity?</label><select id="cra_opp"><option>No</option><option>Yes — competed instead</option><option>Yes — team idle</option></select></div>
        <div><label>Do we still hold documents?</label><select id="cra_docs"><option>No</option><option>Yes — for future re-bid</option><option>Must return to owner</option></select></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="can-card">
      <div class="can-sec">🔁 E · Follow-up</div>
      <div class="can-grid can-g4">
        <div><label>Can it come back?</label><select id="cra_back"><option>Yes — later phase / next budget year</option><option>No, not for now</option><option>Unsure — to be checked</option></select></div>
        <div><label>Follow-up PIC</label><input type="text" id="cra_fpic"></div>
        <div><label>Next contact</label><input type="date" id="cra_next"></div>
        <div><label>Revisit in</label><select id="cra_rev"><option>6 months</option><option>3 months</option><option>12 months</option><option>Do not flag</option></select></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="can-acts">
      <button class="pfu-btn" onclick="craClose()">Cancel</button>
      <button class="pfu-btn" onclick="craClear()">🗑 Clear</button>
      <button class="pfu-btn pif" onclick="craPrint()">🖨 Print / PDF</button>
      <button class="pfu-btn pif" onclick="craSave()" style="background:rgba(139,92,246,.32)">💾 Save</button>
      <span class="can-hint">Saved with the project · does not write into the Tasks table</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>


</body></html>
